480: Patach ribbi abba veamar, (Melachim 1 7:23) vayyaas et hayyam mutzak vegomer. uchetiv omed al shene asar bakar shelosha ponim tzafona ushelosha ponim yamma ushelosha ponim negba vegomer (246 amud alef) vehayyam alehem millemala vegomer. uchetiv veet habbakar shenem asar tachat hayyam (vegomer). omed al shene asar bakar, hachi hu vadday, deda yam mittakna beyv bitren almin, bitresar leela retichin memannan. leela bitresar, letatta teresar shivtin. kevan dechama yaakov tikkuna illaa, vechama shechinta kaim lekovleh, baa leashlama tikkunaha, kara livnohi teresar, veamar lon heasfu. atkinu garmayychu leashlama mehemnuta.

Ta chaze, teresar shivtin, bed diglin, bed sitrin, shelosha ponim tzafona ushelosha ponim yama ushelosha ponim negba ushelosha ponim mizracha vehayyam alehem. vehachi hu vadday, telat shivtin lechol setar led ruche alma, utelat shivtin lidroa dimina, utelat shivtin lidroa dismala, utelat shivtin, leyarcha yemina, utelat shivtin leyarcha semala, vegufa dishchinta alayyhu. hada hu dichtiv, vehayyam alehem.

May tama telat shivtin lidroa, utelat shivtin leyarcha, vechen lecholla. ella raza demilla, telat kishrin inun bidroa yemina, utelat bismala, utelat beyarcha yemina, utelat kishrin beyarcha semala, ishtakkachu teresar kishrin learba sitrin, vegufa alayyhu. ishtakkachu teresar im gufa kegavvna dilela. mena lan, dichtiv, kol elle shivte yisrael shenem asar. vezot, begin devah ishtelim chushebna, kema deittemar vehayyam alehem millemala.

(Zecharya 4:10) shiva ene Adonai, inun shiva ene haeda. shivin sanhedderin. saaraha, kema dichtiv, (Bamidbar 20) kol happekudim lemachane yehuda meat elef vegomer. kol happekudim lemachani reuven, vechen lechullehu.

Vei tema, bemitzrayim bisliku deyaakov mealma, deishtakkach shelimu behahi shata, kulle hay an hu. vadday shivin nafshin havu, vechol inun deolidu bishva esre shenin, delet lon chushebna. kema dichtiv (Shemot 1:7) uvene yisrael paru vayyishretzu vayyirbu vayyaatzmu bimod meod. uchetiv, (Tehillim 40:13) atzmu missaarot roshi. zakkaa chulakeh deyaakov shelema, dehu ishtelim leela vetatta.
Amar ribbi elazar, vadday hachi hu, aval betikkuna illaa deyovela, hech ishtakkach kulle hay. amar leh, arya, kevan desaddar ragloy lemeal becharma, man ihu deayil bahadeh.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Iyov 23:13) vehu beechad umi yeshivennu venafsho ivta vayyaas. hay tikkuna illaa, hu kolla chad, la have beh piruda kehay tattaa, deha ketiv, (Bereshit 2:10) umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim. veaf al gav deit beh piruda, kad yistakkelun mille, kolla salka lechad.

Aval hay tikkuna illaa deyovela, kayyma al teresar, kehay tattaa. veaf al gav deihu chad, hay chad ashlim lechol setar, behay setar, uvehay setar. inun shit sitrin illain terisar havu. dechol chad ozif lechavreh, (158 amud alef) veitkelil minneh, veishtakkachu teresar, vegufa, vecholla kayyma al teresar. man gufa, da yaakov, veha ittemar, ella resha vegufa bechad kayyme.

Tu teresar, telat kishrin didroa yemina chesed chasadim. telat kishrin didroa semala gevura gevurot. telat kishrin beyarcha yemina, netzach netzachim. telat kishrin beyarcha semala, hod vehodot. ha teresar. vegufa kayyma alayyhu ha telesar. tu, bitlesar mechilan orayyta itperash, vecholla chad, meela letatta beyichuda, ad hahu atar dekayyma al piruda.

Shiva aynin illain, illen dichtiv, (Zecharya 4:10) eni Adonai hemma meshottim dechurin, deha atar didchura ihu. hacha (divrei hayamim 2 16) ene Adonai meshottot, betikkune shechinta letatta, atar denukeva (zohar chodesh 33 kayyeyma). shiva aynin illain, lokovel ha dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 29:11) lecha Adonai
481: Haggedulla vehaggevura vegomer. hay atar, ashlim lechol setar.

Tu saara, kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 106:2) mi yemallel gevurot Adonai. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 40:13) atzmu missaarot roshi. uchetiv, (Eicha 3:22) chasde Adonai ki lo tamnu vegomer. vetikkunin illen istallaku (meatar) leatar ochora. veaf al gav dehacha ittemar tefe, veistallik bematkela illaa vetattaa, ushelomo malka amaran, veitztarichna lefarsha lon. zakkaa chulekehon detzaddikaya yattir, deyadin archa dekudesha berich hu, vehacha kolla itgalleyay leyade middin.

Amar ribbi yehuda, zevulun veyissashochar tenay avadu, chad yativ velae beorayyta, vechad nafik veavid perakmatya, vetamich leyissashochar, dichtiv, (Mishlei 3) vetomcheha meushshar. vehava parish beyamme lemebad perakmatya, vechulakeh hachi hava, deha yamma hava achsanteh.

Uvegini kach kare leh yarech. darkeh deyarech lenafka ulemeal, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 33:18) semach zevulun betzetecha veyissashochar beoholecha. lechof yammim yishkon, beinun perishe yammim, lemebad perakmatya. lechof yammim, af al gav dechad yamma hava leh beachsanteh, bitren yammin sharyay.

Ribbi yose amar, kol shear yammin havu mehadderan karpolin beyamma dileh. vehu lechof oniyyot, atar dechol arvin mishtakkechin lemebad sechorata. veyarchato, amar ribbi chizkiyya yarchateh dileh mate al sefar tzidon, utechuma parish lehahu atar, uferakmatya dechol mare sechorata, sacharin vetayyvin bischoratayhu lehahu atar.

Ribbi acha amar, ketiv, (Vayikra 2:13) velo tashbit melach berit elohecha meal minchatecha al kol karbancha takriv melach, vechi ammay melach. ella begin deihu memarek umevassem merira leatama, vei lav have (begin) milcha, la yachil alma lemisbal merira. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:9) ki kaasher mishpatecha laaretz tzedek lamdu yoshve tevel. uchetiv, (Tehillim 89:15) tzedek umishpat mechon kisacha.

Umelach ihu berit dealma kayyma be. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam velayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti. begin kach, ikre berit elohecha, veikre yam hammelach, veyamma ikre al shemeh.

Ribbi chiyyay amar, ketiv, (Tehillim 11:7) ki tzaddik Adonai tzedakot ahev, da milcha beyamma (bemayya). uman deparish lon, garim legarmeh mita. vegin kach ketiv, lo tashbit melach, deha da bela da la azla.

Amar ribbi acha, yam chad hu, veikre (Shemot 48) yammim. ella atar it beyamma deihu mayin tzelilan, vaatar deit beh mayin metikan, vaatar deit beh mayin meriran, vegin kach yammim karinan, veal da lechof yammim. amar ribbi abba, kol shivta veshivta, vechol chad vechad kishra chad, meinun kishrin demitchabberan begufa.
Ribbi abba hava yativ lelya chad vekam lemile beorayyta. ad dehava yativ, ata ribbi yose, uvatash afitcha. amar, sifta betufesra kappetlay shechiche.

Yatvu velau beorayyta. adhachi kam bereh deushepiza veyativ kammayyhu, amar lon may dichtiv, (Yehoshua 2:12) vehachayitem et avi veet immi vegomer. uchetiv unetattem li ot emet. may ka baat minnayyhu. amar ribbi abba yaot shaalt, aval i shamat midi ema beri. amar, tu sheelta, deha inun yahavu lah ma dela vaat minnayyhu, dichtiv, et tikk1vat chut hashshani hazze tiksheri bachalon vegomer.

Ella hachi olifna, hi baat simana dechayye, dichtiv vehachayitem et avi vegomer, vaamara, simana dechayye la sharyay, ela beot emet, umay ihu (Vayikra 2 amud alef) ot emet, da at 6, begin deveh sharyayn chayyin. hachi olifna, simana demoshe ka baat, veinun ammay yahavu lah tikvat chut hashshani.

Ella inun amre, moshe ha istallak mealma, deha itkenish shimsha, veha mata zimna desihara lemishlat, simana desihara it lan lemehav lach, umay ihu, tikk1vat chut hashshani hazze. kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 4:3) kechut hashshani siftotayich. simana dihoshua yehe gabbach, begin deshuletanuta desihara hasheta. kamu ribbi abba veribbi yose
482: Uneshakuhu. amru, vadday zammin ant lemeheve resh metivta, o gavra rabba beyisrael, umannu. ribbi bon.

Tu shail veamar, benoy deyaakov kullehu teresar shivtin, itsadderu letatta kegavvna dilela, ammay akdim bevirchan zevulun leyissashochar tadir, veha yissashchar ishtaddeluteh beorayyta, veorayyta akdim bechol atar, ammay akdim leh zevulun bevirchan. avoy akdim leh, moshe akdim leh.

Ella zevulun zacha al deafik pitta mippumeh, veyahav lefumeh deyissashochar, begine kach akdim leh bevirchan. mehacha olifna, man desaid lemareh deorayyta, natil birchan meela vetatta. vela od ella dezache litre patore, ma dela zache bar nash achara. zache leutera deyitbarach behay alma, vezache lemeheve leh chulaka bealma deate. hada hu dichtiv, zevulun lechof yammim yishkon vehu lechof oniyyot. kevan dichtiv lechof yammim, ammay vehu lechof oniyyot. ella, lechof yammim, bealma den. lechof oniyyot, bealma deate, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 104:26) sham oniyyot yehallechun vegomer, detamman hu negidu dealma deate.

Patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 3:Adonai) hishbati etchem benot yerushalayim im timtzeu et dodi ma taggidu lo shecholat ahava ani. vechi man kariv lemalka kichneset yisrael, deihi amrat im timtzeu et dodi ma taggidu lo. ella benot yerushalayim, illen inun nishmathon detzaddikayay deinun kerevin lemalka tadir, umodin lemalka bechol yoma iskoy dematronita.
Dehachi olifna, beshata denishmata nachatat lealma, keneset yisrael alat alah bekiyyuma deomaa, dichave lemalka, veyoda leh rechimuta dilah legabbeh, begin leitpayysa bahadeh.

Uvemma, begin dechiyyuva al bar nash leyachada shema kaddisha befuma, belibba benafsha, uleakkeshshera kolla, keshallehova deitkashshera betifsa, uvehahu yichuda deavid, garim leitpayysa malka bematronita, veoda leh lemalka rechimuta dilah legabbeh.

Davar acher, benot yerushalam, illen teresar shivtin. detaninan, yerushala 40 al teresar turin kayyma. uman deamar al shiva, la kaamar leashlama shelimu, veaf al gav decholla chad, deit shiva, veit 4, veit teresar, vecholla chad.

Vadday al teresar turin kayyma, telat turin lesitra da, utelat turin lesitra da, vechen learba zivvyayn, ucheden itkere chayya. kema deat amer, (Yechezkel 10:20) hi hachayya asher raiti tachat elohe yisrael. veillen ikrun benot yerushalayim, begin dekayyma alayyhu. veinun sahade sahaduta lemalka al keneset yisrael. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 122:4) shivte yah edut leyisrael lehodot leshem Adonai. amar ribbi yehuda, zakkaa chulekehon deyisrael, deyade orchoy dekudesha berich hu, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 14:2) ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha uvecha bachar Adonai vegomer:

Yissashchar chamor garem rovetz ben hammishpetayim. amar ribbi elazar, vechi yissashchar chamor ikre. i begin deishtaddal beorayyta, nikreyeh leh sus o arye, o namer, ammay chamor. ella amru, begin dachamor natil matula, vela bait bemareh kishar beire, vela it beh gassut haruach, vela chayyish lemishkav beatar mittakkan. uf hachi yissashchar, deishtaddeluteh beorayyta, natil matula deorayyta, vela bait beh bekudesha berich hu, vela it beh gassut haruach, kachamor dela chayish likara dileh, ella likara demareh (sefer acher derabbeh). rovetz ben hammishpetayim, kidamrinan veal haaretz tishan, vechayye tzaar tichye, uvattora atta amel.

Davar acher yissashkar chamor garem rovetz vegomer. patach veamar, (Tehillim 27:1) ledavid Adonai ori veyishi mimmi ira Adonai maoz chayyay mimmi efchad, kamma chavivin inun millin deorayyta, kamma chavivin inun demishtaddele beorayyta, kamme kudesha berich hu. dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta, la dachil mippige alma, natir hu leela, natir hu letatta. vela od, ella
483: Dechafit lechol pegie dealma, veachit lon leumeke dithoma rabba.

Ta chaze, beshata deal lelya, (leel 172 amud alef) patchin setimin, vechalbe vachamare sharyayn veshatan bealma, veityeyhivat reshu lechabbala, vechol bene alma nayyme bearsayyhu, venishmathon detzaddikayay salkin leitanaga leela. kad itar ruach tzafon, veitpelig lelya, itaruta kaddisha itar bealma, veittemar bechamma duchete.

Zakkaa chulakeh dehahu bar nash, deihu kaim behahi shata, veishtedal beorayyta. kevan deihu patach beorayyta, kol inun zinin bishin, ail lon benukeve dithoma rabba, vechafit leh lachamor, venachit leh betafsere ditchot afra, dezuhame kisra.

Begine kach, yissashchar, deishtaddeluteh beorayyta, kafet leh lachamor, venachit leh. mehahu geram hammaalot, deihu salik lenizka alma, veshavve madoreh ben hammishpetayim, ben zuhame detafseri deafra.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv. vayyar menucha ki tov veet haaretz ki naema vayyet shichmo lisbol vayhi lemas oved. vayyar menucha ki tov, da tora shebbichtav. veet haaretz ki naema, da tora shebbeal pe. vayyet shichmo lisbol, lemisbal ula deorayyta, uledavka bah yome velele. vayhi lemas oved, lemehve palach lekudesha berich hu, uleitdabbeka beh, uleattasha garmeh bah.

Ribbi shimon veribbi yose veribbi chiyyay havu ka azle miggalila illaa litverya, amar rabbi shimon, nehach venishtaddal beorayyta, dechol man deyada leishtaddela beorayyta, vela ishtaddal, itchayyev benafsheh. vela od ella deyahavin leh ula deara, veshibuda bisha, dichtiv beyissashochar, vayyet shichmo lisbol, mahu vayyet, sata. kema deat amer, (Shmuel 1 8:3) vayyattu achare habbatza. man desata archeh vegarmeh, dela lemisbal ula deorayyta, miyyad vayhi lemas oved.

Patach ribbi shimon veamar, (Mishlei 8:21) lehanechil ohavay yesh veotzrotehem amalle. zakkain inun bene alma, inun demishtaddele beorayyta, dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta, itrachim leela, veitrachim letatta, veachsin bechol yoma, yeruta dealma deate. hada hu dichtiv, lehanechil ohavay yesh. may yesh. da alma deate dela pasak memoy lealmin, venatal agar tav illaa, dela zache beh bar nash ochora, umay ihu. yesh. uvegine kach, ramiz lan shema deyissashochar deishtaddal beorayyta, yesh sachar. da hu agra deinun demishtaddele beorayyta, 310.

Ketiv, (Daniel 7:9) chaze havet ad di charsavavn remiv veattik yomin yetiv vegomer. chaze havet ad di charsavavn remiv, kad itcharav be makdesha, tere karsavavn naflu, tere leela, tere letatta. tere leela, begin deitrechikat tattaa meillaa, kurseyay deyaakov itrechikat mikkurseyay dedavid. vekurseyay dedavid naflat. hada hu dichtiv, (Eicha 2:1) hishlich mishshamayim eretz. teri karsavavn letatta, yerushala 40, veinun mare deorayyta. vecharsavavn diltatta kegavvna decharsavavn dilela, marehon deorayyta hayeynu kurseyay deyaakov. yerushala 40 hayeynu kurseyay dedavid, veal da ketiv, ad di karsavavn, vela karseya. karsavavn saggiin naflu, vechullehu la naflu, ella meelbonah deorayyta.

Ta chaze, kad inun zakkae keshot mishtaddele beorayyta, kol inun tukefin dishar ammin, dishar chelin, vechol chelin dilhon, itkafyayn vela shalte bealma, veyisrael (nusach acher 316) izdamman alayyhu lesalka lon al kolla. vei la, chamor garma lon leyisrael lemehach begaluta, uleminpal bene ammemaya, ulemishlat alayyhu. vechol da ammay, begin, vayyar menucha ki tov, umittakna kammeh, veyachil lemirvavch beginah kamma tavin vechamma kissufin, vesata orcheh dela lemisbal ula deorayyta. vegin kach vayhi lemas oved.

Ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 6) haddudaim natnu reach veal petachenu kol megadim chadashim gam yeshanim vegomer. haddudaim natnu reach, (haddudaim) illen inun deashkach reuven. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 30:14) vayyimtza
484: Dudaim bassade, vela itchaddeshan mille deorayyta, ella al yedoy beyisrael, kema deat amer, (divrei hayamim 1 12:33) umibbene yissashchar yode bina leittim vegomer.

Veal petachenu kol megadim, inun garmu lemeheve al petachenu, al pitche batte chenisiyyot uvatte midrashot, kol megadim. chadashim gam yeshanim, kamma mille chaddetan veattikin deorayyta, deitgalleyayn al yadayyhu, lekarva leyisrael laavuhon dilela. hada hu dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 12:33) ladaat ma yaase yisrael.

(Shir HaShirim 7:14) dodi tzafanti lach. mehacha olifna, kol man deishtaddal beorayyta kedka yeut, veyada lemechede millin, ulechaddetute millin kedka yeut, inun millin salkin ad kurseyay demalka, ucheneset yisrael patach lon tarin, veganiz lon. uveshata deal kudesha berich hu leishtashea im tzaddikayyay beginta deeden, afikat lon kammeh, vekudesha berich hu mistakkel behu vechade, keden kudesha berich hu mitattar beitterin illain, vechade bematronita, hada hu dichtiv, chadashim gam yeshanim dodi tzafanti lach. umehahi shata, milloy ketivin besifra, hada hu dichtiv, (Malachi 3:16) vayyikkatev sefer zikkarun lefanav.

Zakkaa chulakeh, man deishtaddal beorayyta kedka yeut, zakkaa hu behay alma, vezakkaa hu bealma deate. ad hacha shuletanuta dihuda, deroa deitkelil bechola, bechela dechol sitrin, telat kishrin didroa, leitgabbera al kolla:

Dan yadin ammo keachad shivte yisrael. ribbi chiyyay amar, hay kera hachi it le lememar, dan yadin leshivte yisrael, o dan yadin leshivte yisrael keechad, mahu dan yadin ammo, ulevatar keachad shivte yisrael. ella dan, hu dichtiv beh, (Bamidbar 10:25) meassef lechol hammachanot, dehu yarcha semala, veazil levatrayyta.

Ta chaze, kevan dihuda ureuven natlin, levae vaarona parsin diglin, venatil digla deefrayim deihu lemaarav, yarcha yemina natil, bekafsire kista. vei tema zevulun deihu al, venafik, dichtiv beh, (Devarim 33:18) semach zevulun betzetecha, uchetiv veyarchato vegomer. ella vadday, yehuda itkelil mikkolla.
Ta chaze, malchu dilela itkelil mikkolla, vihuda ihu malchu tattaa. kema demalchu illaa itkelil mikkolla, hachi name malchu tattaa, itkelil mikkolla miggufa miyyarcha, begin leitgabbera betukefeh.

Ketiv, (Devarim 33) mimino esh dat lamo, (74 amud alef) orayyta missitra digvura ityeyhiv (ityeyhivat), ugevura itkelil bimina, uvegufa, veyarcha, uvecholla. hachi name sidra kadmaa, yehuda ihu, malchu deate missetar gevura, veitkelil bimina begufa uveyarcha, becholla itkelil. kema demalchu dilela, itkelil mikkolla.

Siddera tinyayna reuven, deihu listar darom, vedarom ihu yemina, vechol chela dimina, yehuda natil leh, begin diruven (sefer acher itavid) itavir minneh malchu, kema deat amer pachaz kammayim al totar, venatil leh yehuda, veitgabbar betukefa dimina, dehava meruven, vechen ketiv bedavid, (Tehillim 110:1) neum Adonai ladoni shev limini. begin dissemala itkelil bimina, veittakkaf becheleh, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 118:15) yemin Adonai osa chayil vegomer. yehuda ureuven teren deroin havu.
Siddera telitaa, efrayim, deihu yarcha yemina, venatla kamme semala tadir, vedan (da) deihu yarcha semala, natil levatrayyta, veal da hu hameassef lechol hammachanot letzivotam, veazil levatrayyta.

Yehuda natil chela bitren deroin, begin diruven deihu yemina, (sefer acher itavir) itavid minneh becheruta kehunnata umalchuta, veal da ketiv bihuda, (Devarim 33:7) yadav rav lo veezer mitztzarav tihye.

Ta chaze, ketiv, (Melachim 1 10:16) vayyaas hammelech shelomo kisse shen gadol. kurseyay dishlomo, avad leh kegavvna dilela, vechol diukenin (dehacha) dilela avad hacha. veal da ketiv, (divrei hayamim 1 29:23) vayyeshev shelomo al kisse Adonai lemelech, melech milla setima hu. vechen (Melachim 1 2:12) ushelomo yashav al kisse david aviv vattikkon malchuto meod, dekayyma sihara beashlamuta.
Dan yadin ammo bekadmita, ulevatar shivte yisrael keachad, keyichudo shel olam
485: Kema dehava beshimshon, deihu yechiday avid dina bealma, vedain vekatil kechada, vela itzterich semech.

Dan yadin ammo. ribbi yitzchak amar, dan, hayeynu chivya, kamin al orchin ushevilin. vei tema deal shimshon bilchodoy hu. uf hachi name leela, da hu nefesh ochora (sefer acher nachash zuta) meassef lechol hammachanot, vechamin leorchin ushevilin. levatar, chelin umashshiryayn mehacha nafke, inun dechaman livne nasha, al chovin, deramin lehu laachora batar kitfayyeyhu. amar ribbi chiyyay, nachash hakkadmoni leela, ad dela yitbassam bechamra dechedu.

Nachash ale derech. ta chaze, kema deit derech leela, hachi name it derech letatta, umitparsha yamma, lechamma orchin bechol setar. veit orcha chad, deate veasge yamma, verabbe nunin bishin liznayyhu, kema daafiku mayin letatta nunin tavin, (Shemot 30) nunin bishin, nune uredanaya, kegavvna da, nunin bishin liznayyhu.

Vechad mishtammeshe mearcha deyamma, itchazun rachvin al susayyhu. veilmale dehay chivya, deihu kanish lechol mashshiryayn, kamin lesof archin, uvaddar lon laachora, havu metashteshe alma. missitra dehanne nafkin chorashin lealma. ta chaze, bevilam ketiv, (Bamidbar 24:1) velo halach kefaam befaam likrat nechashim, begin deinun kayymin lelachasha bacharashe alma.

Chame ma ketiv, yehi dan nachash ale derech. may ale derech. ella nachash, man deishtaddal avatreh, akkechish fammalya dilela, umay ihu, hahu derech illaa denafak milleela. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 43:16) hannoten bayyam derech vegomer. nachash, man deishtaddal avatreh, keilu azil al hahu derech illaa leakkechasha leh, begin dimhahu derech, itzanu almin illae.

Vei tema, dan, ammay ihu bedarga da, ella kedichtiv, (Bereshit 3:24) veet lahat hacherev hammithappechet lishmor et derech etz hachayyim. hachi name hannoshech ikve sus vegomer, begin lenatra leh lechol mashshiryayn. amar ribbi elazar, tikkuna dechuresyay ihu. ta chaze, kurseyay dishlomo malka, chad chivya merafref bekitture sharvita leela mearyevata.

Ketiv, (Shoftim 13:25) vattachel ruach Adonai lefaamo bemachane dan vegomer. ta chaze, shimshon nezir olam hava, ufaresh alma ihu, veitgabbar beh chela takkifa, vehu hava chivya behay alma, lokovel ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, deha achsanat chulaka devirchata dedan avuhi yarit, dichtiv, yehi dan nachash ale derech vegomer.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, nachash yedia, shefifon may nihu. amar leh, raza detikkuna dachorashin, denachash ihu shefifon, hachi name hahu rasha devilam, becholla hava yada. ta chaze ketiv, (Bamidbar 23:3) vayyelech shefi, lezimnin behay, ulezimnin behay.

Vei tema dan, lav dargeh behay. hachi hu vadday. ella itmanna al darga da (lehahu), lemeheve sitra batrayyta, ushevacha ihu dileh, memannan demalka behay, umemanna al hay, vikara ihu lechol inun memunnin. vekurseyay demalka, bechol inun memannan ittakkan, bechol hanne memannan techotayyhu mitparshan orchin vedargin, hen letav, hen levish, vechullehu itachadan behanne tikkune dekurseyay. uvegini kach dan listar tzafon, benukeva dithoma rabba. distar tzafon kamma chavile terikin izdammenan tamman, vechullehu tafsira dekistera leavasha alma.
Begine kach tzalle yaakov veamar, lishuatcha kivviti Adonai. bechol shevatim la kaamar lishuatcha ella behay. begin dechama leh tukefa takkifa dechivya, merachasha dina leitgabbera.

Ribbi yose veribbi chizkiyya havu azle lemecheme leribbi shimon bekapputekiyya, amar ribbi chizkiyya, hay deamrinan leolam yesadder bar nash shevacha demareh, ulevatar yetzalle tzeloteh, hay man delibbeh tarid, uvae letzallaa tzeloteh, veihu beaku, vela yachil lesaddera shevacha demareh kedka yeut, may hu.
Amar leh, af al gav dela yachil lechavvevna libba ureuta, siddura veshivcha demareh ammay gara, ella yesadder shivcheh demareh, af al gav
486: Dela yachil lechavvevna, vitzalle tzeloteh. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 17:1) tefilla ledavid shima Adonai tzedek hakeshiva rinnati, shima Adonai tzedek bekadmita, begin deihu siddura deshivcha demareh. ulevatar hakeshiva rinnati haazina tefillati. man deyachil lesaddera shevacha demarih, vela avid, aleh ketiv, (yeshaya 60) gam ki tarbu tefilla enenni shomea yedechem vegomer.

Ketiv, (Shemot 29:39) et hakkeves haechad taase babboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim. tefillot keneged temidin tikkenum. ta chaze, beitaruta diltatta, itar hachi name leela. uveitaruta dilela, hachi name leela minneh, ad demate itaruta leatar devaya butzina leadlaka veadlik. uveitaruta ditnana diltatta, adlik butzina leela, vechad hay adlik (butzinin), kullehu butzinin ochoranin dalkin, umitbarchan minneh kullehu almin. ishtakkach, deitaruta dekarbana tikkuna dealma, uvirchan dealmin kullehu.

Ha chetzad, share tenana lesalka, inun diukenin kaddishin dimmannan al alma ithannun (sefer acher atetakenan) leatara, umitarin ledargin bechissufa dilela, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 104:21) hakkefirim shoagim lattaref vegomer. illen itarin ledargin illain dealayyhu, ad demate itaruta, ad devae malka leitchabbera bematronita.

Uvechissufa diltatta, navin mayin tattain, lekivla mayin illain, deha la navin mayin illain, ella beitaruta dechisufa diltatta, ucheden tiuveta itdabbak, venavin mayin tattain lokovel mayin illain, vealmin mitbarchan, uvutzinin kullehu delikan, veillain vetattain mishtakkeche bevirchan.

Ta chaze, kohane velevae. mitare leitchabbera semala bimina. amar ribbi chizkiyya, kolla hachi hu vadday, aval hachi shemana, kohane velevae, da itar semala, veda itar yemina, begin deitchabberuta didchura legabbe nukeva, lav ihu ella bismala vimina. kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni. ucheden itchabbar dechar benukeva, vetiuveta ishtakkach, vealmin mitbarchin, veillae vetattae bechedu.

Veal da, kohane velevae, mitare milla letatta, leitara kissufa vachavivuta leela, decholla talya bimina usemala. ishtakkach dekarbana yesoda dealma, tikkuna dealma, chedu deillain vetattain. amar ribbi yose vadday shappir ka amart, vehachi hu, vehachi shemana milla, veanshena lah, veana shemana ha, vecholla bechad salka.

Hasheta tzelota beatar dekarbana, uvee bar nash lesaddera shevacha demareh kedka yeut, vei la yesaddar, lav tzeloteh tzelota. ta chaze, siddura shelim deshivcha dekudesha berich hu, man deyada leyachada shema kaddisha kedka yeut, divhay mitarin illain vetattain, venagde birchan lechullehu almin.
Amar ribbi chizkiyya, la ashre kudesha berich hu leyisrael begaluta bene ammaya, ella begin deyitbarchun shear amin beginehon, deha inun nagdin birchan milleela letatta kol yoma.

Azlu, ad dehavu azle, chamu chad chivya dehava kamaschar (vaasater) bearcha. satu mearcha. ata bar nash ochora legabbayyhu, katil leh chivya. ahadaru reshayyhu, vechamu leh, lehahu bar nash demit. amru, vadday hahu nachash, shelichuta demareh ka avid. berich rachamana deshezvinana.

Patach ribbi yose veamar, yehi dan nachash ale derech. ematay hava dan nachash, beyomoy diravam, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 12:29) veet haechad natan bedan ammay ityeyhiv tamman ale derech. al hahu orach, deyitmena (hahu derech desallekin) dela yislekun lirushalam (velo yesalkun tamman). veda dan, hava lon nachash leyisrael ale derech, ale derech vadday, kema deat amer, (Melachim 1 12:6) vayyivvaatz hammelech vegomer. shefifon ale orach. deakitz lon leyisrael. vecholla la hava ella ale derech, vaale orcha, leitmenaa miyyisrael dela yislekun lirushalam, lemechag chagayyhu, ulekarava karbanin veillavvavn, lemiflach tamman.
487: Ta chaze, beshata dematu birchan lida demoshe, levarcha lechullehu shevatim, chama ledan dehava katir bechivya, ahadar katar leh bearya. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 33:22) uledan amar dan gur arye yezannek min habbashan. may tama, begin (deihu) dihe sheruta vesofa ded diglin katir bihuda deihu malka, kema deat amer, gur arye yehuda, vehu sheruta dediglin. vesofa dediglin dan, dichtiv dan gur arye vegomer, lemehevi sheruta vesofa katir bechad atar:

Lishuatcha kivviti Adonai, ribbi chiyyay amar, (kedichtiv) kema deat amer, (Shoftim 13:5) vehu yachel lehoshia et yisrael miyyad pelishtim. amar (sefer acher rabbi acha), vechi ammay kivviti veha salik hava yaakov mealma behahu zimna mikkamma shenin. ammay amar deihu mechakke lehahu yeshua. (sefer acher ella vadday) amar leh vadday raza demilla, kedichtiv, (Shemot 17:11) vehaya kaasher yarim moshe yado vegavar yisrael, yisrael setam. uf hacha vehu yachel lehoshia et yisrael, yisrael setam. begine kach amar, lishuatcha kivviti Adonai. amar ribbi chiyyay. vadday hachi hu, veshappir. zakkaa chulekehon detzaddikayay, deyade leishtaddela beorayyta, lemizke bah lechayyin dilela. kema deat amer, (Devarim 30:20) ki hu chayyecha veorech yamecha lashevet al haadama vegomer.

Gad gedud yegudenu vehu yagud akev. ribbi yesa amar, miggad ishtema, deha chelin yifkun laagacha kerava, mashma dichtiv gad, bechol atar gimel (234 amud bet) dalet, chelin umashshiryayn nafke minnayyhu. deha gimel yahiv, vedalet lakit. umehacha (nusach acher mashka) kamma chelin vechamma mashshiryayn talyayn behu.

Ta chaze, hahu nahar denagid venafik meeden, la paskin memoy lealmin, vehu ashlim lemiskene, veal da kayyme kamma chelin vechamma mashshiryayn, veittezanu mehacha. veal da gad, da appik veyahiv, veda lakit venakit, veittezan beta vechol anshe beta.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, illemale dehave gad mibbene shefachot, shata kayyma leh leashlama yattir mikkola. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 30) ba gad keri, uchetiv bagad chaser alef, deha shata kayyma bishlimu, veistallak minneh. hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 6:15) achay bagdu chemo nachal, begin dehahu nahar denagid, istallak behahi shata, uchetiv bagad chaser alef, veal da, la zacha beara kaddisha veistallak minah.

Ribbi yehuda amar, minnayin liruven dehava kehay gavvna, kedichtiv, pachaz kammayim al totar deistalleku mayin vela negidu, veha ittemar bemma afgim. vetarvavyyhu la zachu beara kaddisha, vechelin umashshiryayn afiku leachsana lehu leyisrael ara. ta chaze, ma deittefagim begad, ishtelim beasher, hada hu dichtiv, measher shemena lachmo vehu yitten maadanne melech. hasheta ashlim gimel ledalet.

Ribbi elazar veribbi abba ishtemitu bimarta delud, dealu kamme tukefa deshimsha, dehavu azle bearcha. amar ribbi abba naschar hay mearta bemille deorayyta. patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Shemot 114 amud alef) (Shir HaShirim 8:6) simeni kachotam al libbecha kachotam al zeroecha vegomer, reshafeha rishpe esh shallehevet yah, hay kera itarna beh. aval lelya chad hava kad havena kaim kamme abba, veshamana minneh milla, delet shelimu ureuta vechissufa dichneset yisrael bekudesha berich hu, ella (68 amud bet) benishmathon detzaddikayay. deinun mitare neviu demaya tattae, lekivle illae. uvehahi shata shelimu diruta vechissufa bidviku chada lemebad perin.

Ta chaze, batar deitdabbeku da beda, vehi kabbilat reuta, hi amarat simeni chachotam al libbecha, ammay chachotam. ella archeh dechotam, kevan deitdabbak beatar chad, af al gav deitade mineh, ha ishtaar reshimu behahu atar, vela aade minneh. dechol reshimu, vechol diukena dileh, beh ishtaar. kach amra keneset yisrael, ha itdabbakna bach, af al gav deitade minach veazil
488: Begaluta. simeni chachotam al libbecha, begin deyishtaar kol deyukeni bach, kehay chotam deyishtaar kol diukeneh, behahu atar deitdabbak beh.

Ki azza chammavt ahava, takkifa hi, kifrishu derucha min gufa. detaninan, beshata debar nash mate leistallaka min alma vechame ma dechame, rucha azla bechol (Vayikra 126 amud bet) shayyfe degufa vesalik galgalloy, keman deazil beyamma bela shayyaytin, salik venachit vela mehaneyay leh, ata veishtail mikkol shayyfe gufa, velet (lon) takkifu keyoma deparish rucha min gufa. kach takkifu dirchimu dechneset yisrael legabbe kudesha berich hu, ketakkifu demota, beshata devae rucha leitperasha min gufa.

Kasha kishol kina, kol man derachim, vela kashir immeh kina, lav rechimuteh rechimuta. kevan dekanne, ha rechimuta ishtelim. mikkan olifna devae bar nash lekannaa leinteteh, begin deyitkashshar immah rechimuta shelim, deha miggo kach la yahiv enoy beintu ochora. mahu kasha kishol. ella, ma sheol kashya beenayyhu dechayyayvin lemechat beh, kach kina kashya beenayyhu deman derachim vekanne, leitperasha merchimuta.

Davar acher, kasha kishol kina, ma sheol, beshata denachatin lon lechayyayvaya beh, modiin lon chovayyhu al ma nachatin leh, vekashya lehu. kach, man dekanne, hu tava al choveh, vechashiv (nusach acher vacheshayd) kamma ovadin, ucheden kishshura dirchimuta itkashshar beh.

Reshafeha rishpe esh shalhevet yah. man shalhevet yah, da shalhova deittokda venafka miggo shofar, deihu itar veokid, uman ihu, semala. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi. da okid shallehova dirchimu dichneset yisrael legabbe kudesha berich hu.

Uvegine kach, (Shir HaShirim 8:7) mayim rabbim lo yuchelu lechabbot et haahava. deha kad ate yemina deihu mayim, osif yekidu dirchimuta, vela kave shalhova dismala, kema deat amer vimino techabbekeni, hay ihu mayim rabbim lo yuchelu lechabbot et haahava, vechen kolla kehay gavvna.

Ad dehavu yatve, shamu kaleh deribbi shimon, dehava ate beorcha, hu veribbi yehuda veribbi yitzchak. kariv limarta, nafku ribbi elazar veribbi abba. amar ribbi shimon, mikkotle dimarta chamina dishchinta hacha. yatvu. amar ribbi shimon bemay askitu. amar ribbi abba, birchimuta dichneset yisrael legabbe kudesha berich hu, veribbi elazar parish hay kera bichneset yisrael, simeni chachotam al libbecha vegomer. amar leh, elazar birchimu illaa ukeshiru dachavivuta istakkalt.

Ishtik ribbi shimon shata. amar, bechol atar bayay shetiku, bar shetiku deorayyta. ginza chada it li geniza, vela baena deyitavid minnayychu, vehi milla illaa, veashkachna lah besifra derav hamenuna sava.

Ta chaze, bechol atar dechura radif batar nukeva, veitar legabbah rechimuta, vehacha ashkachna, dehi itarat rechimuta veradfa avatreh, veorcheh dealma, delet shevacha denukeva, lemirdaf batreh didchura. ella, milla setima hi, umilla illaa deve ginzayay demalka.

Ta chaze, telat nishmatin inun, veinun salkin bedargin ilain yedian, veal deinun telata arba inun. chad nishmata illaa dela ittefas, vela itar beh gizbera (sefer acher giza) dekartitaa illaa, kol shekken tattaa. vehay nishmata lechol nishmatin. vehu satim, vela itgalleya lealmin, vela ityeyda, vechullehu beh talyayn.

Vehay itattaf beittufa dezahara decharmela, (nusach acher divdolcha) bego zehiruta venatif tippin tippin margelan veitkashsheru kullehu kechad, kekishrin deshayyfe degufa chad. vehu ail begavvavyeyhu, veachaze behu avidteh. hu veinun chad hu, velet behu perishu. hay nishmata illaa temiru decholla.
Nishmata ochora, nukeva demittammera bego chelaha, vehi nishmata lehu, uminnayyhu achida
489: Gufa, leachazaa behu avidta lechol alma. kegufa deihu mana lenishmata, lemebad beh avidta. veillen kegavvna deinun keshirin temirin dilela.

Nishmata ochora, hi nishmathon detzaddikayay letatta. nishmathon detzaddikayay atyayn meinun nishmatin illain, minnishmata denukeva, uminnishmata didchura. uvegin kach, nishmatin detzaddikayay illain, al kol inun chelin umashshiryayn dilela.

Vei tema, ha illain inun mitteren sitrin, ammay nachatin lehay alma, veammay istalleku minnih. lemalka deityeylid leh bar, shaddar leh lechad kefar, lemarba leh ulegaddela leh ad deyitrabbe (leh), veyolfun leh arche dehechala demalka. shama malka deha bereh rav veitrabbe. ma avad birchimu divreh, meshadder lah lematronita immeh begineh, veail lehechleh, vechade immeh kol yoma.

Kacha kudesha berich hu, olid bar vematronita, umay ihu, nishmata illaa kaddisha, shaddar leh lichfar, lehay alma, deyitrabbe beh, veyolfun leh orche dehechala demalka. kevan deyada malka deha bereh itrabbe behay kefar, veidan hu lemayyte leh lehechaleh. ma avad birchimu divreh, meshadder lematronita begineh veail leh lehechaleh. nishmata la salka mehay alma, ad deatat matronita beginah, veailat lah behechala demalka, veyativat tamman lealmin.

Veim kol da, orcha dealma, deinun beni kefar bachan al perishu divreh demalka minnayyhu. chad pikkeach hava tamman, amar lon, al ma attun bachan, vechi lav bereh demalka ihu, vela itchaze lemedar yattir benayychu, ella behechala deavoy. kach moshe, dehava pikkeach, chama bene chefar dehava bachan. al da amar, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem lo titgoddu.

Ta chaze, illu havu yadin kullehu tzaddikayyay hay, havu chadan hahu yoma demate lon leistalleka mehay alma. vechi lav yekara illaa hu, dematronita atat beginayyhu, uleovala lon lehechala lemalka, lemechede behu malka kol yoma, deha kudesha berich hu la ishtasha ella benishmathon detzaddikaya.

Ta chaze, itaruta dirchimu dechneset yisrael, legabbe kudesha berich hu, nishmathon detzaddikaya letatta mitarin lah. begin deinun atyayn missitra demalka, missitra didchura, veitaruta da mate lenukeva missitra didchura, veitar rechimuta. ishtakkach didchura itar chavivu urechimuta lenukeva, ucheden nukeva itkashsherat birchimuta, legabbe dechura.

Kehay gavvna, tiuveta denukeva lemishde mayin tattain lokovel mayin illain, lav ihu ella benishmathon detzaddikaya. zakkain inun tzaddikaya behay alma, uvealma deate, dealayyhu kayymin illain vetattain. veal da (Mishlei 10:25) vetzaddik yesod olam ketiv, setam.

Veraza decholla, tzaddik, ihu yesoda dilela, veihu yesoda letatta, uchenset yisrael itkelilat mitztzaddik, milleela umittatta. (153 amud bet) tzaddik mehay sitra, vetzaddik mehay sitra, yartin lah. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 37:29) tzaddikim yirshu aretz. yirshu aretz vadday. ta chaze, tzaddik achsin lah lehay eretz, vearik alah birchan bechol yoma, veyahiv lah tafnukin veiddunin, bingidu illaa denagid alah, veha (235 amud bet) okimna milla.

Veraza dichtiv (Bereshit 49:20) measher shemena lachmo vehu yitten maadane melech. veim kol da, milla ochora, kema dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 6:9) rauha banot vayashruha, veal da amra lea, (Bereshit 30:13) beashri ki ishsheruni vanot vecholla shappir. veta chaze mealma deate, itmeshich venagid lehay tzaddik, lemehav tafnukin veiddunin lehay eretz, deihu lechem oni, veitavid lechem pannag, hada hu dichtiv, measher shemena lachmo vehu yitten maadanne melech vday, veha (77 amud bet) okimna.
490: Ta chaze, measher shemena lachmo. da hu atar decholla meashrin leh. umay ihu, alma deate. deillae vetattae meashrin leh, umikkassefin leh. shemena lachmo, man, ad kan la parish man hu atar. ella, it lechem, veit lechem, kema deit ilana, veit ilana. it ilana dechayye, veit ilana detalyay beh mota. it lechem deikre lechem oni, veit lechem deikre lechem pannag. uman ihu (lechem). da 6, veda hu lachmo, lechem 6. veal da ketiv, (Shemot 16:4) hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim, min hashshamayim vadday.

Veal da, measher shemena lachmo, lechem 6, deha mineh ittezan hay ilana, vehu meattera leh, kedichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:11) baatara sheittera lo immo. vechad ihu nakit, vadday hu yitten maadanne melech. uman melech. da keneset yisrael, deha minneh ittezanat, vehu yahiv lah al yeda detzaddik, darga kaddisha at kayyayma. umehacha lishar dargin diltatta, vechullehu kegavvna dilela.

Besifra derav hamenuna sava, amar hachi, measher shemena lachmo, (leel 47 amud bet) da lechem shabbat, deihu panag, al chad teren. kedichtiv, (Shemot 16:22) laktu lechem mishne. may lechem mishne. ella, tere lechem, lechem min hashshamayim, velechem min haaretz. da hu lechem pannag, veda hu lechem demiskena, uveshabbat itkelil lechem tattaa belechem illaa, veitbarech hay begini hay, veihu lechem mishne.

Vetu hava amar, lechem mishne deshabbat, nakit mishshabbat illaa, deihu nagid veanhir lecholla, veitchabbar lechem belechem, veihu mishne. uvechol atar, raza delechem, nukeva hi. begin kach shemena ketiv velo shamen. uchetiv, (Bereshit 49) ki im hallechem asher hu ochel, da inteteh.

Vei tema (Shmuel 1 9:7) vehallechem azal mikkelenu, vela ketiv azlat. shear mezona lechem karinan leh, veishtemodan millin, man hu shear mezona, uman hu lechem mammash. lechem dilela, bechol atar dechar, lechem tattaa, bechol atar nukeva veanan ashkechina dezimnin ketiv dechar, ulezimnin nukeva, vecholla chad milla, hay kehay, veshappir kolla.

Ta chaze, asher, rashim leela verashim letatta, betikkuni kalla. vechullehu teresar shivtin yamma kaim alayyhu, veittakkan behu. hada hu dichtiv, (Melachim 1 7:25) vehayyam alehem millemala. veraza demilla, ittakkan leela veittakkan letatta beara. ittakkan leela betikkunin yedian, kegavvna dealma illaa. veittakkan letatta vehane teresar shivtin kogavvna dilela. veal da shechinta leela ushechinta letatta beginayyhu (begavvavyyhu) deyisrael, uvitresar shivtin (nusach acher uvitren shivtin) (nusach acher uvitren sitrin) itkelilat veittakkanat. asher betikkunaha kayyma, kishar shivtin.

Vei lav degale moshe, la ityeyda. dichtiv, (Devarim 33:24) vetovel bashshemen raglo. leachazaa an hu kishra dileh beatrih, deihu nagid hahu meshach revut milleela. begini kach ketiv, baruch mibbanim asher vegomer.

Ribbi shimon patach veamar naftali ayyala shelucha hannoten imre shafer. ha ittemar, dealma illaa alma didchura ihu, kevan desalka milla mikkenset yisrael uleela, kolla hu dechar. menalan, meola, ammay itkere ola, begin desalka leela min nukeva. uvegine kach, (Vayikra 1:3) ola zachar tamim yakrivennu vegomer.

Ammay tamim, vechi piske piske beinan leh, deamar tamim, mahu tamim. ella, kedichtiv, (Bereshit 17:1) hithallech lefanay vehye tamim. ematay tamim, beshata (sefer acher baatar) deitgezar, deha dechura la have, vela ishtemoda, ella behahu atar deikre tamim. uman ihu, da at kayyayma, deveh ishtemoda dechura min nukeva. kedichtiv, (Bereshit 6:9) ish tzaddik tamim haya. begine kach zachar tamim, deishtemoda beh hay shayyfa, vela yesarsun leh.

Vei tema, ha ketiv, (Vayikra 4:32) nekeva temima. hachi hu vadday, kema deikre tzaddik tamim, kach ikre tzedek temima. begin decholla, natla minneh, begine kach, ola desalka min nukeva lidchura, umehay atar uleela, kolla hu dechura. umin nukeva
491: Uletatta, kolla hu nukeva, veha okimna.

Vei tema, hachi name nukeva dilela. ela, siyyuma degufa achaze al kol gufa deihu dechar, resha degufa nukeva, ad denachit lesiyyuma, vechad siyyuma itchaze, ha avid kolla dechar. aval hacha, resha vesofa nukeva, deha kol tikkun gufa nukeva.

Ta chaze, chad raza illaa it bemilla da, deha chaminan deyaakov barich leyosef bego achohi, kevan demanne kudesha berich hu arba degalim bishchinta, bitresar shivtin leittakkena behu, gara minnayyhu leyosef, veshavve leefrayim beatreh. may tama istallak yosef minnayyhu. i tema begin chovoy, lav hachi, deha zakkaa ihu.

Ella, raza demilla, yosef reshima didchura hava, dichtiv ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin. uchetiv mishsham roe even yisrael, mittamman ittezan hay even yisrael. even, da keneset yisrael, veala amar david (Tehillim 118:22) even maasu habbonim hayta lerosh pinna. uvegin deyosef ihu reshimu didchura, ikre yosef hatztzaddik, deha ihu tzaddik vadday, mishsham roe even yisrael.

Uvegin dechol tikkune shechinta inun nukevan, istallak yosef mittamman, veitmanne techoteh efrayim, veihu nukeva letikkunaha. uvegin deihu hachi, itmanne listar maarav, atar denukeva sharya, vehahu reshimu deihu dechura, istallak mittikkunaha, begin deihu alma denukeva, vela alma didchura, vechol tikkunaha bayayn nukeve.

Uvegin kach, yosef deihu tzaddik, istalok mittikkunaha, veitmanne efrayim techoteh. veal da, kullehu teresar shivtin, tikkuni shechinta inun, vechullehu bayayn kegavvna dilela, bar darga detzaddik, deihu avid kol shayyfin dechar, vela bae leakkechasha (nusach acher leh).

Naftali ayyala shelucha hannoten imre shafer, hayeynu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:3) umidbarech nav, begin dekol madbar leh ledibbur, velet kol bela dibbur. vehahu kol ishtallach meatar amika dilela, usheliach mikkammeh, leanhaga ledibbur, deha let kol bela dibbur, vela dibbur belo kol. veda kelal detzarich lifrat, uferat detzarich lichlal. veda kol nafka middarom, umadbar lemaarav, yarit litren sitrin. veda hu dichtiv, (Devarim 33:23) ulenaftali amar vegomer, yam vedarom yerasha, leela dechar, letatta nukeva, begin kach naftali ayyala shelucha nukeva letatta. kegavvna da dechar leela, dichtiv hannoten imre shafer, hannoten ketiv, velo hannotenet.

Ta chaze, machshava reshita decholla, uvegin deihi machshava, ihi lego setima vela ityeyda. kach itpashshat hay machshava yattir, atya leatar derucha sharya, vechad mate lehahu atar ikre bina, veha lav satim kidkadmita, veaf al gav deihu satim, hay rucha itpashshat, veappik kala, kalil meeshsha umaya verucha, deinun tzafon vedarom umizrach. vehay kala, kelala dechol shear chelin, vekala da madbar ledibbur, veda yahiv milla betikkuna, begin dekol ishtallach meatar derucha, veate ledabbera milla, leafaka millin teritzin.

Vechad tistakkel bedargin, hu machshava, hu bina, hu kol, hu dibbur, vecholla chad, vehi hi machshava, reshita decholla, vela have perud, ella kolla chad, vekishshura chad, deihu machshava mammash itkashshar beayin, vela itparash lealmin, veda hu (Zecharya 14:9) Adonai echad ushemo echad. veal da, hannoten imre shafer ketiv, da gufa.

Siyyuma degufa da, dichtiv ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin, ammay tere zimne. ella ben porat leela. ben porat letatta. veammay lav ihu ben porat letatta, betikkuni matronita. begin devanot tzaada, lemeheve ale shur, devayayn banot letikkunaha vela vanim. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 31:29) rabbot banot asu chayil vegomer. rabbot banot asu chayil, illen teresar shivtin.
Ta chaze, malchuta kaddisha, la kabbil malchuta kaddisha shelemata, ad deitchabbar baavahan, vechad itchabbar baavahan, itbene binyayna shelema (bevinyayna shelema) mealma
492: Illaa, deihu alma didchura, vealma ilaa ikre 7 shenin, begin dechullehu 7 shenin beh.

Vesimanicha (Melachim 1 6:38) vayyivnehu sheva shanim, da alma illaa, vela ketiv besheva shanim, kema deat amer, (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz, vela ketiv besheshet uchetiv, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, beavraham. veavraham, 7 yamim ikre, uveh itbeni alma illaa, (sefer acher kegavvna da vayyivnehu sheva shenayim) veillen ikrun alma didchura (sefer acher uveh itbene alma letatta).

Kegavvevna da letatta it shenin, raza dealma tattaa, veraza da, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 5) 7 yamim vez yamim 14 yom. dechevan deamar shivat yamim veshivat yamim, la yedana dearbesar inun. ella, leachazaa alma illaa, vealma tattaa. veinun shivat yamim veshivat yamim. illen dechurin, veilen nukevin. illen nukeve hay alma alayyhu. dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:29) rabbot banot asu chayil, illen teresar shivtin, deinun asu chayil. kedichtiv, (Bamidbar 2:9) kol happekudim lemachani yehuda vegomer, vechen kullehu.

Vei tema rabbot, veha teresar inun, vela yattir, bar hahu chayil deavdu, may rabbot. ella kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 18:20) zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba, kemo gadla. vechen rabbot gedolot, illain, veravrevin al kolla. veillen ikrun chayyot gedolot. asu chayil, hahu chayil deavdu dismichin alayyhu, ikrun chayyot ketannot im gedolot, leitchabbera kechada, leittakkena behu matronita, lemechede behu illain vetattain. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 104:26) livyatan ze yatzarta lesachek bo, begini kach rabbot banot asu chayil. (sefer acher veet alita al chullana kema deat amar, 2 omed al shene asar bakar shelosha ponim tzafona ushelosha vegomer uchetiv vehayyam alehem millemala hayeynu veet alita al chullana).

Veal da vanot tzaada ale shur. banot tzaada, tzaadot mibbae leh, ella hahu ayin dichtiv leela, umon ihu, en mishpat, veihu kaim ale ayin, veihu ayin, tzaada, ufasat lemetal banot letikkunaha, vehayeynu banot tzaada, vela vanim, banot tzaada, istakkelat letikkunaha, vela vanim. vaymararuhu varobbu, beistakkeluta dirchimu legabbeh. kedichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 6:Adonai) hasebbi enayich minnegdi shehem hirhivuni. veal da vayyistemuhu baale chitztzim.
Vatteshev beetan kashto da keshet. ma keshet da bat zugo. beetan, tukefa albishat aloy, dela achlashat chela, deha yadat deyosef la yiste behahu darga, deat kayyayma dileh, limina velismala.

Vayyafozu, may vayyafozu. ella kedichtiv, (Tehillim 19:11) hannechomadim mizzahav umippaz rav. uchetiv, (Iyov 28:17) utemuratah keli paz. ityaykru derooy bemargalita illaa. midi avir yaakov, meinun teren sitrin, deatkif behu yaakov. mishsham roe even yisrael, mittamman ittezan hahu even yekara, kidkaamaran. tu, meinun teresar sitrin, ittezan hahu even yekara, deinun tzafon vedarom, vehi ityayhavat benayyhu, veitbarcha minayyhu, veittezna minhon al (darga) yeda detzaddik.

Ta chaze, leyosef ittosaf leh beracha ochora, kema deat amer, meel avicha veyaazrekka vegomer. hay kera kashya. meel avicha, el avicha yaazrekka mibbae leh. may meel avicha ulevatar yaazrekka. veet shadday, veel shadday mibbae leh, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 43:14) veel shadday yitten lachem rachamim lifne haish. vivarachekka, yevarechcha mivae leh.

Ela achsin leh leela vetatta. achsin leh leela, meel avicha, deihu achsana illaa, atar deikre shamayim. veyaazi reka, begin dela yachalif hay atar leatar ochora, vesiyyua dileh leheve meatar da, vela meachara.

Veet shadday, mahu veet shadday, ella, ihu darga ochora tattaa, deha taninan, bechol atar et Adonai, da shechinta, kemo (yeshaya 6) vaere et Adonai, et lerabbot. veet leachlala yom belayla, velayla beyom, kedichtiv veet shadday, deha mittamman nafkin birchan levarcha almin.

Tu, ammay la kaamar veel shadday, deha hacha name mashma kidkaamrinan. dichtiv, veel shadday yitten lachem rachamim, kolla atar chad hu, ammay shavak 30 vechatav 400. ella raza ihu, dechad inun shevilin nafkin meela,
493: Kelala deorayyta, achsin shamayim. kema deat amer et hashshamayim, kelala dechv atvavn. umehacha nafke letora shebbeal pe deikre eretz, kidkaamrinan veet haaretz, kelala dechv atvavn. veshamayim kalil kolla kechada, ucheden mitatra sihara becholla, veyatva beashlamuta, uvirchan nagdin keden mittamman, veal da veet shadday.
Vivarchecha, begin dihe leh kiyyum tadir veyattir, deha bechol atar deit beh vav, tosefet it leh, vekiyyuma. ad kan kelal, ulevatar avid perat, dichtiv birchot shamayim vegomer:

Birchot avicha gavru al birchot horay. birchot avicha gavru vadday, deha yaakov achsin shevacha decholla, yattir meavahan, deha hu shelim hava becholla. vecholla yahav leh leyosef, may tama. begin dehachi itchaze, deha tzaddik kolla natil, veachsin kolla kechada, vechol birchan beh sharyayn. hu arik birchan merisha leela, vechol shayyfe gufa kullehu ittaknan, laaraka beh birchan, ucheden itavid nahar denafik meeden.

May meeden, ella, bechol shata dechol shayyfin yatvin bekishshura chada, veinun beidduna detiuveta meresha leela uletatta, vechullehu meidduna vetiuveta dilhon, merikin beh, veitavid nahar denagid venafik meeden vadday. tu meeden mechachma illaa, nagid kolla leitmashshecha, veavid nahara, veitmashcha ad demate lehay darga, ucheden kolla bevirchan, vecholla chad.

Ad taavat givot olam, (sefer acher hay ad) tiuveta deinun givot olam. umay ninhu, tere nukeve. chad leela, vechad letatta, dechol chad ikre olam. vetiuveta dechol shayyfe gufa, beinun teren immahan. tiuveta leyanka meimma illaa. tiuveta leitkashshera beimma tattaa. vetiuveta decholla chad, begin kach kullehu, (kedka chaze). tihyena lerosh yosef vegomer, leitbarcha hahu darga detzaddik, ulenatla kolla. kedka chaze.

Zakkain inun deikrun tzaddikim, deha tzaddik la ikre, ella man denatir hay darga, hay at kayyayma kaddisha. zakkain inun bealma den, uvealma deate. nafku min mearta, amar ribbi shimon, kol chad vechad lema milla, venehach bearcha.

Patach ribbi elazar kera avatreh, binyamin zeev yitraf vegomer. binyamin zeev yitraf, zeev ammay. ella begin dehachi itreshim bekurseyay, deha kol chevavn ravrevin zeirin reshimin tamman. kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:25) chayyot ketannot im gedolot. vekurseyay deavad shelomo, hachi itreshim, kegavvna dilela.

Tu zeev yitraf, deha mizbeach bechulakeh hava. umizbeach ihu zeev. dei tema binyamin ihu zeev, lav hachi. ella mizbeach dehava bechulakeh, hu zeev, dehava achil bisra chol yoma uvinyamin hava zan leh, begin deha bechulakeh hava, kivyachol ihu mefarnes vezan lehay zeev. tu zeev yitraf, zeev yazun. uman ihu, illen mare devavu, deinun kayyme leela lekatrega, vechullehu ithanu veittaknan mikkarbana, umitare itaruta leela.

Babboker ychal ad velaerev yechallek shalal. may vabboker ychal ad. ella betzafra, deavraham itar bealma, veshata deraava ishtakkach, karbana avid itaruta venayycha vesalka ad 74. hahu atar, dichtiv, (Devarim 30:2) veshavta ad Adonai elohecha.

Tu babboker, may babboker, da avraham kidkaamaran, dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:3) vayyashkem avraham babboker, bezimna deraava ishtakkach, behahi shata la hava achil karbana ochora, uman hava achil, hahu atar deikre 74, veihu kurseyay illaa, deihu ade ad, kedichtiv ade ad vegomer.
Uzeman achila, betzafra dead hu, vehay ad, (hachi nammi) leela (hachi itkere), dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:4) bitchu baAdonai ade ad. uvabboker, hayeynu karban laAdonai, vaday. ychal ad, vela ochora.
Tenana salik, veitaruta dirchimu kashir, veitar leela vekayyma da lokovel da,
494: Venura (nusach acher usheraga) dalik, veanhir behay itaruta diltatta. vechahana itar, velevae meshabbechan, veachzeyayn chedu, ucheden chamra itnesach, leitkashshera bemaya, vechamra nahir veachaziyi chedu, begini kach, chamra tav letatta, leachazaa chedu, lechamra ochora dilela, vecholla itar, leitkashshera semala bimina.

Velechem deihu (Vayikra 247 amud alef) solet, malchuta deitar itaruta, naktin lah semala bimina, umekashre lah begufa, ucheden nagid mishcha illaa, velakta leh al yeda detzaddik. veal da bae lemebad itaruta desolet bemishcha, veitkashshar kolla kechada, ucheden idduna venayychin deyichuda chad, velaktin idduna venayycha deyichuda, kol inun kitrin, veitkashshar da beda, veitnahir sihara, veitkashshera beshimsha, veyativ kolla beidduna.

Ucheden karban laAdonai, vela leochora. veal da, babboker ychal ad, vela leochora (74), yochal ad, veyitadan veyitkashshar bekishshureh bekadmita. ematay, babboker. devae leitbarcha shema kaddisha bekadmita, ulevatar yitbarchun ochoranin.

Veal da, asir leh lebar nash levarcha lechavreh betzafra, ad divarech lekudesha berich hu, deihu bae leitbarcha berisha, vehayeynu babboker ychal ad. ulevatar yitbarchun ochoranin, velaerev yechallek shalal. deha karbanot dehava beresha, kolla itkerav lekudesha berich hu, veitaruta salka tamman. uvegin deha hu itbarach, hava mekashshar kishrin lechol shear chelin illain, umaflig lon birchan, lechol chad vechad kedka chaze veyaot leh, umitbasseman almin, veitbarchan ilain vetattain.

Vehayeynu raza dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) achalti yaari im divshi vegomer, bekadmita, levatar palig lechullehu, veamar, ichlu reim shetu veshichru dodim. arik birchan lechullehu, umaflig lon, lechol chad vechad kedka chaze leh, veal da velaerev yechallek shalal. deha shema kaddisha yitbarach bekadmita, vehasheta palig birchan lechullehu almin. dela tema dekarbana mitkarev lon, vela leshum chela ochora, ella kolla mitkarev lekudesha berich hu, vehu arik birchan, umaflig birchan lechullehu almin, uvegin kach karban laAdonai, vela leochora.

Amar ribbi shimon, beri, shappir ka amart. tu itaruta ochora dekarbana, kolla begin leamshacha birchan, uleatara birchan, deyitbarchun kullehu almin. bekadmita karban laAdonai, vela leochora, hasheta takrivu et karbanchem, deyitkashsherun kullehu almin kechada, veyitchabberan veyitbarchun illae vetattae.

Patach ribbi abba veamar kera avatreh, kol elle shivte yisrael shenem asar vegomer, kol elle shivte yisrael, elle shivite yisrael mibbae leh, may kol elle. ella, leachbera (sefer acher lemechtam) lon, beatar dechol birchan merikin tamman. shenem asar. shenem asar vadday, kishrin detikkune matronita, veihi itchabberat bahadayyhu, hada hu dichtiv shenem asar. vezot asher dibber lahem avihem vayvarech otam, deha beatar da, dibbur sharya.

Asher dibber, hacha kishra chad, leitchabbera mittatta leela, umeela letatta. mittatta, beillen teresar shivtin, vezot, itchabbera bahadayyhu. asher dibber, ha chibbura dechar venukeva, kishshura litren sitrin, mittatta umilleela, lesof kashar lon beatar dilela, dechar venukeva kechada. hada hu dichtiv ish asher kevirchato vegomer. may kevirchato. ella kevirchato bat zugo. ish asher kevirchato tarvavyeyhu kechada.

Patach veamar, (tehillim la) yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon uree betuv yerushalam vegomer, yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon, deminneh nafkin birchan, leashkaa leginta. vehu kalil kol birchan, veyahiv lah, ulevatar uree betuv yerushalam. leachazaa dechol birchan atyayn middechar venukkeva. kegavvna da (Bamidbar 7) yevarechcha Adonai veyishmerecha. yevarechcha Adonai middechura. veyishmerecha minnukeva. yevarechcha Adonai mizzachor. veyishmerecha mishshamor. vechola chad milla, begin demittarvavyyhu nafkin birchan lealmin. veal da, ish
495: Ribbi yehuda patach kera veamar, vaykal yaakov letzauot et banav vegomer. vaychal yaakov letzauot et banav, letzauot, levarech mibbae leh. ella depakkid lon legabbe shechinta, leitkashshera bahadah. tu, depakkid lon al iske mearta, dehi keriva legan eden, detamman hu adam harishon kavur.

Ta chaze, hahu atar ikre kiryat arba. may tama. begin detamman itkevaru arba zugot, adam vechavva. avraham vesara. yitzchak verivka. yaakov velea. ha kusheya hacha, detaninan, avahan inun reticha kaddisha, ureticha lav pachot mearba, vetaninan kudesha berich hu ichabbar lemalka david bahadayyhu, veitavidu reticha shelemata, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 118:22) even maasu habbonim vegomer. dedavid malka itchabbar lemehve reticha shelemata bahadayyhu. i hachi david baya (nusach acher leitkashshera) leitkevara bego avahan, veyehve kiryat arba bahadeh, may tama la itkabbar bahadayyhu.

Ella, david malcha atar mittakkan hava leh kedka yeut, uman hu tziyyon, leitchabbera leh kechada. veadam deitkabbar bego avahan, ha inun itkevaru bahadeh, begin deihu melech kadmaa hava, veitavar minneh malchu, veityehav ledavid malka. umiyyomoy deadam, itkeyyaym david malka. deadam elef shenin itgezar aloy, veitavaru minneh shivin shenin, yomoy dedavid malka, vehu yahiv lon. veavahan hech yekumun ad deyete david malka, ella zacha leatreh, kedka chaze leh, begine kach la itkevar legabbe avahan.
Tu, avahan beatar didchura sharyayn, vedavid beatar denukeva, vaavahan nukevan itkevaru bahadayyhu. vedavid itkevar veitchabbar beatar didchura, milla kedka chaze leh.

Vayyeesof raglav el hammitta, begin deha ihu beatar dechayyin yativ. kad baa leistallaka mealma, nachit ragloy legabbe mitta, veitkenish veistelak mealma, hada hu dichtiv, vayyigva vayyeasef el ammav.

Petach veamar, (Tehillim 84:3) nichsefa vegam kalta nafshi lechatzrot Adonai, milla da ha ukemuha chavrayay. avalotta chaze, it madorin tattain, veit madorin illain. beillain lav (madorin) sharyayn tamman, uman inun, inun batte gavae, uvatte berae. inun ikrun chatzrot Adonai, begin deinun kayyme birchimu vetiuveta legabbe nukeva. ta chaze, kad nishmata sa leka itar kolla legabbe nukeva, deha ihi itachadat betiuveta shelemata veitkashsherat beh.

Yaakov la mit, vegin kach la ittemar beh mota, ella vayyigva vayyeasef el ammav. chame ma ketiv, vayyeesof raglav el hammitta, deitkenish shimsha legabbe sihara, shimsha la mit, ella itkenish mealma, veazil legabbe sihara.
Ta chaze, beshata deitkenish yaakov, itnehir sihara, vetiuveta deshimsha illaa itar legabbah, begin deshimsha kad salik, itar shimsha ochora, veitdabbak da beda, veitnehir sihara.
Amar ribbi shimon, shappir ka amart, aval ha ittemar, deillaa alma didchura, itkashshar betattaa deihu alma denukeva, vetattaa itkashshar beillaa, vecholla da kegavvna da.

Veha ittemar teren almin ninhu, kedichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 16:36) min haolam (153 amud bet) vead haolam. veaf al gav ditren nukeve ninhu, chad mittakkan bidchura, vechad benukeva. da sheva (shabbat), veda bat sheva. da em, veda em, da ikre em habbanim, veda ikre em shelomo. kedichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:11) tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo vegomer. bammelech shelomo, bammelech dechol shelama dileh. da em shelomo. kedichtiv, (Melachim 1 1:11) bat sheva em shelomo.

Uchetiv, (Melachim 1 Adonai:10) vatterev chachmat shelomo. chachmat shelomo, da em shelomo. dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:1) divre lemuel melech massa asher yisrattu immo. divre lemuel melech, hay kera lav ityeyda mahu setima dileh. ella, divre lemuel melech, devarim deittemar begin el
496: Deihu melech, uman ihu. da (tehillim 7) el zoem bechol yom. veel shadday. kema deittemar.
Lemuel kema deat amer, (Iyov 40:4) lemo fi. lemuel melech, deihu bat sheva. massa asher yisrattu immo, kad itgeli aloy begivon, bechelma delelya.

Ta chaze, yaakov itkenish legave sihara, veavid bah perin lealma. velet lach dara bealma, dela it beh ibba deyaakov, begin deha ihu itar itaruta leela, begin dichtiv, vayyesof raglav el hammitta, deihu mittateh deyaakov vadday.

Zakkaa chulakeh deyaakov, deha ishtelim leela vetatta, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 30:10) veatta al tira avdi yaakov neum Adonai vegomer ki ittecha ani. ki itti atta la ittemar, ella ki ittecha ani, veha ittemar.

Ribbi yitzchak patach veamar, vayyavou ad goren haatad vegomer, uchetiv, vayyar yoshev haaretz hakkenaani et haevel begoren haatad vegomer. hanni kerae it leistakkala behu, may ichpat lan deinun atu ad goren haatad. umay tama itkanat aveluta da lemitzrayim, deha evel yisrael mibbae leh, may tama lemitzrayim.

Ella hachi amru, kol hahu zimna dehava yaakov bemitzrayim, itbarach ara begineh, venilus hava nafik veashke ara, veod defasak kafna begineh deyaakov. veal da, mitzrae avadu aveluta, veitkanne alayyhu.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 106:2) mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato, hay kera ukemuha. aval mahu yemallel, yedabber mibbae leh. vei tema dearcheh dikra hachi hu, deha kerae inun hachi. la. dechullehu leachazaa milla ka atyayn. uf hacha, leachazaa mila ka atya, mi yemallel (gevurot Adonai), kedichtiv, (Devarim 23:26) vekatafta melilot. gevurot Adonai, begin desaggiin inun, deha kol gezera dedina, mittamman ka atya, veal da, man ihu disallek veyaaver gezera chada, meinun gevuran deavid kudesha berich hu.

Tu, mi yemallel, vidabber, kolla chad. yedabber, deha kamma vechamma gevuran inun, delet lon chushebana, kamma mare dedinin, kamma mare teresin, kamma gardine nimmusin, umillula la yachil lemallala lon.

Uvemma yedian, kullehu behaggada, deit beh raza dechachmeta, deha bemillula uvaamira la yachil lemallala lon. leminda lon, aval behaggada yedian, kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 145:4) dor ledor yeshabbach maasecha ugevurotecha yaggidu, beraza da yadin, aval gevuratecha dehi gevura tattaa, yedabberu, dichtiv ugevuratcha yedabberu.

Yashmia kol tehillato, desaggiin inun (nusach acher dargin) dinin, deishtemodan umitchabberan bithilla, vechamma chelin, vechamma mashshiryayn demitchabberan bah, kedichtiv, (Iyov 25:3) hayesh mispar ligdudav, veal da, man yachil leishtema kol tehillato.

Ta chaze, mitzrae kullehu chakkimin havu, umissitra digvura ka nafke, kamma chelin vechamma mashshiryayn, vechamma dargin al dargin, ad dematu legabbe dargin tattain, umitzrae havu chorashin vechakkimin behu, veyadin setimin dealma, veistakkalu ha, debzimna deyaakov kayyaym bealma, la it amma deshalta al benoy, veyadu deha yishtabedu behu beyisrael zimnin saggiin.

Kevan demit yaakov chadu, istakkalu ma yehe besofa, ad dematu legoren haatad, deihu gezera dedina shallita, atad begimatriyya yad, kema deat amer, (Shemot 14:31) vayyar yisrael et hayyad haggedola vegomer, kevan dematu leatar da, chamu gevuran denafke mehay atad. ammay ikre atad. ella, ma atad nafke kuvin lehay sitra ulehay sitra, hachi name yad, nafke minah etzbaan, lehay sitra ulehay sitra, vechol etzbaa veetzbaa salik bechamma gevuran, bechamma dinin, uvechamma nimmusin, keden vayyispedu sham misped gadol vechaved meod al ken kara shemah avel mitzrayim, vadday evel kaved ze lemitzrayim, vela leochora.
Ribbi shimon parish parshata. nafke yatvu lego mearta. amar chamena deyoma den yinpol beta bemata, viadrun tere romae mekatregin. i ana bemata la yinpol beta. ahadaru lego mearta yatvu.
Patach ribbi shimon veamar, (Yeshayahu 10:30) tzahali kolech bat gallim vegomer.
497: Tzahali kolech, hay kera lichneset yisrael ittemar, begin deihi meshabbachat leh lekudesha berich hu, bekala meshabbecha, veal da tzahali kolech. mehacha olifna, kol man devae leshabbecha lekudesha berich hu bekala, baya leh kala neimuta, deyeerav leochoranin deshamin leh, vei lav, la yakum laarama kala.

Ta chaze, levae deatyayn missitra da, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 8:25) umibben chamishshim shana yashuv mitztzeva haavoda vegomer. may tama. begin dekaleh (dargeh, vei) namich, vela yeerav leudenin, kishar chavroy, keden meavrin leh mehay tzeva haavoda (macheyylayn) dilela, dekayymin lenaggana legabbe hay avoda, uleyakkera shema kaddisha kedka chaze.

Chelin leela, chelin umashshiryayn legabbe tattae, leshabbecha shema kaddisha, ulezammera lon. uvegini kach yashuv mitztzeva haavoda. uvegin dichneset yisrael ka meshabbecha leh lekudesha berich hu, amar kera, tzahali kolech bat gallim, bat avahan.

Tu, bat gallim, alma deate ikre gallim, begin decholla kayyma beh, veitkelil beh tille tillim, venafka minneh lecholla. tu bat gallim, kedichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:12) gal naul, vechol inun gallim umabbuin, kullehu nafke mealma deate, uchenset yisrael ihi bat gallim.

Ta chaze, hay kera kashya, bekadmita ketiv tzahali kolech, dehu begin lezammera velaarama kala, ulevatar ketiv hakeshivi. i hachi ammay tzahali kolech, kevan dichtiv hakeshivi. ella, tzahali, begin leshabbacha ulezammera. ta chaze, i yisrael sharan leshabbecha ulezammera lekudesha berich hu, keden ketiv hakeshivi, may tama, begin deyisrael inun meshabbechan umezammeran beginah lekudesha berich hu, veal da ketiv tzahali kolech, uchetiv hakkeshivi.

Laysha, begin deatya missitra digvura, kema deat amer, (Mishlei 30:30) layyish gibbor babbehema. vehay laysha, gevura, letabbera chelin vetukefin. aniyya anatot, begin deihi aspaklarya dela nahara (ala), aniyya vadday, let lah nehora lesihara miggarmah, ella ma deyahiv lah shimsha.

Anatot ihu chakal, kefar chad, vesharyayn beh kohani miskeni deahadran al pitchin (delevae), velet man deyashgach behu, begin dechol inun bene hahu kefara (sefer acher kaleysheyn), kelisin havu beenayhu deamma, uvetayyhu reykanyayn yattir mikkol amma, bar ma deyahavin lon, kemiskene (sefer acher kaleysheyn) kelisin deamma. begin kach, sihara let lah nehora miggarmah, ella beshata deitchabbar immah shimsha itnehir.

Ta chaze, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 2:26) uleevyatar hakkohen amar hammelech anatot lech al sadecha ki ish mavet atta. vechi al dezammin leh adoniyyahu, ish mavet ikre. ella, begin dehava meatar miskena, deidbak beh sihara, deihi aniyya anatot.

Vei tema, (Melachim 1 2:26) vechi hitannita bechol asher hitanna avi, begine kach zakkaa dela katil leh. ella evyatar, begin dehava meatar miskena, zacha beh david, ad la salik lemalchu, kad hava mechamman leh shaul, vehave archoy kemiskena, (levatar) evyatar kegavvna da, ulezimna deshalat shelomo, sihara kayyma beashlamuta, vehava bechedvavta daatiru, decholla hava leh, la zacha beh evyatar.

Vadday sede anatot, raza demila hava, veyirmeya dekane leh, kolla hava, begin leachsana raza illaa. ta chaze, kad shalta sihara, sede tappuchim ikre, kad ihu bemiskenu, sede anatot. begine kach, tushebachta diltatta, avid leh atiru, ushelimuta.

Kema dedavid, kol yomoy ishtaddal lemebad shelimu lah, ulenagna zammare, lezammera uleshabbecha letatta. vechad david istallik mealma, shavik lah bishlimu, ushelomo natal lah beutera, bishlemuta, deha sihara nafka mimmiskenu, vealat leutera, divhach utera, shalat al kol malche ara.

Veal da (Melachim 1 6) en kesef nechshav bime shelomo. ella kolla dehav, deitrabbe dehav, uvehahu zimna ketiv, (Iyov 28:6) veafrot zahav lo, deha afar dilela, hava mistakkel beh shimsha, uveistakkeluta deshimsha vetukefeh, afra avid veasge dehav.
Ta chaze, mitture dinhiru, detukefa deshimsha tamman, afra
498: Deara bene ture, kullehu avde dehav, veilmale chevavn bishin dirviu tamman, bene nasha la havu miskene, begin detukefa deshimsha asge dehav.

Vegin kach, beyomoy dishlomo, en kesef nechshav limuma, deha takkifa deshimsha istakkal beafra, veasge leh dehav. veod dehahu afra, sitra dedina ihu. kad istakkal beh shimsha, natal tukefa veitrabbe dahava. kevan deistakkal shelomo bah, shabbach veachriz veamar, (Kohelet 3:20) hakkol haya min heafar vegomer.

Veal da shelomo la itzterich lenagna kedavid, ella shirata deihu rechime deutera, dehu nehiru urechimu dechol tushebchan dealma beh havu, tushebachta dematronita kad yatva bekurseyay lekovleh demalka kaamar.

Ketiv, (Melachim 1 10:27) vayyitten hammelech et hakkesef birushalam kaavanim, begin decholla hava dehav, veafra itkashshar bissemala, besitra dirchimu. kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi, veshimsha itdabbak bahadah, vela itade minah.

Shelomo taa behay, deha chama deitkeriv sihara beshimsha, vimina mechabbeka, usemala techot resha, kevan deitkerivu da beda, amar, ha itkerivu kechada, yemina ma hacha. deha yemina lav ihu ella begin lekarva, kevan deitkerivu da beda lemay itzterich, miyyad en kesef nechshav bime shelomo.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu, ant dachit yemina, chayyaych, ant titztarech lechesed bene nasha, vela tishkach. miyyad sata shimsha millekabbel sihara, vesihara sharya leitchashshecha, vehava shelomo mehaddar al pitchin, veamar, (Kohelet 1:12) ani kohelet, vela hava man deyaavid immeh chesed, may tama, begin dedacha yemina, vela chashiv leh. hada hu dichtiv, (Melachim 1 10:21) en kesef nechshav bime shelomo limuma.

Veal da, kol deasge tushebchan legabbe kudesha berich hu, asge shelama leela, begine kach hakeshivi laysha. ketiv, (Iyov 6) layyish oved mibbeli teref vegomer, layyish hayeynu laysha, kedichtiv, chak chukka. oved, kedichtiv, (Yeshayahu 27:13) uvau haovdim. mibbeli taref, begin, deihi tava (sefer acher ila) aleha lemehav, kedichtiv, (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah.

Uvene lavi yitparadu. begin dechullehu chayaylin, kad ihi yehivat lehon teref, kullehu mitchabberan kechad, veyankin kechad. vechad ihi yatva mibbeli teref, degaram galuta, vadday bene lavi yitparadu, mitparshan kullehu lechamma sitrin vearchin, begin leashkacha lemebad dina. veal da, bezimna dekarbana itavid, kolla mittaknan, umitkarvin kechada kidkaamaran. hasheta dekarbana lo itavid, vadday bene lavi yitparadu, uvegine kach, let lan yom dela ishtakkach beh dina, deha la mitarin illain vetattain bishlimu illaa kidkaamaran.

Ta chaze, hasheta tzelota debar nash, itar shelimu leela vetatta, uvevirchata devarich lekudesha berich hu, mitbarchin illain vetattain. veal da bitzlota deyisrael mitbarchan almin. man dimvarech leh lekudesha berich hu, yitbarach. man dela barich lekudesha berich hu, la yitbarach. hada hu dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 2:30) ki mechabbeday achabbed uvozay yekalu.

Rav hamenuna sava, kassa devirchata la yahiv leh lebar nash ochora levarcha, (devae laatanetalea) ela ihu akdim venatil leh (bimina uvismala) bitre yedoy umevarech. veha amaran, devae lenatla leh bimina (sefer acher velo bismala) uvismala, veaf al gav decholla itaru beh, shappir hu. aval kassa divracha hachi itzterich kos, dichtiv, (Tehillim 116:13) kos yeshuot essa, deha behay kos, itnegidu birchan meinun yeshuot dilela, vehu natil lon, vechanish lon legabbeh, vetamman itnetir (lon) chamra illaa veitkenish behahu kos. uveinan levarcha leh bimina, (sefer acher uvismala) velo bismala, vechamra deihu behay kos kanish, deyitbarchun kechada, uveinan levarcha patora, dela tehe rekanya minnahama vechamra, kolla (chad) kechada.
Ta chaze, keneset yisrael, kos shel beracha ikre, vechevan deihu kos shel beracha, beinan yemina usemala (uvae) lenatla leh, vehahu kos ityeyhiv ben yemina
499: Usemala, uvae deitmalyay chamra, begin chamra deorayyta, deihu nafik mealma deate.

Veta chaze, kos shel beracha, (hacha) behay itgalyayn millin illain, hacha deanan bimarta, ema hacha itgalleyay raza dirticha kaddisha. kos shel beracha bae lekabbela leh bimina usemala, da tzafon vedarom, vechos shel beracha dihe natil beracha minnayyhu. man kos shel beracha, da mittato shellishlomo, divinan deityeyhiv ben tzafon ledarom, uvae laanacha lah bimina, vegufa deyittakken bahadayyhu, veyashgach beh behahu kos, levarcha leh bearba birchan, begin dichtiv, (Devarim 11:12) tamid ene Adonai elohecha bah vegomer. ishtakkach bechos shel beracha, raza dimhemnuta, tzafon vedarom umizrach umaarav, ha reticha kaddisha kedka chaze leh.

Ufatora benahama, begin deyitbarcha hahu lechem diltatta, veyitbarach lechem oni, vihe lechem pannag, veha okimna. veyishtakkach dichneset yisrael mitbarcha bed sitre alma, leela vetatta leela (behahu nahama shel beracha). vechos shel beracha, leitchabbera david malka baavahan, veyitbarach letatta, deyitbarach (nusach acher ufatora benahama begin deyitbarech mikkol sitrin meella umittatta leella beraza dechos shel beracha leitchabbera david malka baavahan vaytaberach letatta deyitbarech lechem avoni vihe lechem pannag veha ukemuha vaytaberach) patora debar nash, leishtakkecha beh mezona tadir.

Kamu kullehu uneshaku yedoy, amru berich rachamana deailna hacha, ushemana millin illen. nafku min mearta veazlu, kad alu bemata, chamu itra divne nasha demitu, denafal beta alayyhu, yatvu vechamu deka safde leinun demitu, im inun romae.

Patach ribbi shimon veamar vayyavou ad goren haatad, man goren haatad. ella, hacha itremez shaltanuta demitzrae deitade. goren haatad, da memanna shuletana demitzrae, deitade mikkamme shuletanuta deyisrael, deha chamu (gaveran). kema deat amer, (Melachim 1 22:10) melubbashim begadim baggoren. veal da vayispedu sham misped gadol vechaved meod vegomer.

Al ken kara shemah avel mitzrayim ad hayyom hazze, devadday mimmitzrayim hava, uf hacha lav deyudae ninhu illen bachyayn, af al gav demitu beh yudae, veillen yudae, illemale havu yudae, la mitu, vechevan demitu, kudesha berich hu mechapper chovayyhu.

Amar ribbi shimon ta chaze, deyaakov af al gav denafkat nishmateh bemitzrayim, lav birshuta ochora nafkat. may tama, kema deittemar, dela hava miyyoma deitbere alma arsa shelemata kehahu arsa deyaakov. beshata dehava salik mealma nishmateh, miyyad itkashshar beatreh, veha okimna.

Ta chaze, kad hava al yaakov bimarta, kol rechin deginta deeden ishtakkach bimarta, umearta salka nehora, usheragga chad dalik. vechad alu avahan legabbe deyaakov lemitzrayim, leishtakkacha immeh, istallak nehora desharga. kevan deal yaakov bimarta, hadera sheraga leatreh, keden ishtelim mearta mikkol ma deitzterich.

Vead yome alma, la kabbilat mearta bar nash ochora, vela tekabbel. venishmatin dezachan iavran mikkammayyhu beve mearta, begin deyitarun, vechamin zara dishvaku bealma, veyechodu kamme kudesha berich hu. amar ribbi abba, chanita deyaakov may ihu, amar leh, zil sheil leasya.

Ta chaze, ketiv vaytzav yosef et avadav et harofim lachanot et aviv vayyachantu harofim et yisrael, salka datach kishar beni nasha hava chanita da. i tema begin orcha hu deavadu, ha ketiv vayyamat yosef ben vegomer vayyisam baaron bemitzrayim, ha la azlu immeh bearcha, deha tamman itkabbar, uchetiv vayyachantu oto.

Ella, archa demalchin inun, begin lekayyma gufayyhu, chanate lon bimshach revut, illaa al kol mishchin, meorav bevusemin, veshaiv leh begufa yoma batar yoma behahu mishcha tava, arbein yomin. dichtiv, vayyimleu lo arbaim yom ki chen yimleu yeme hachanutim. batar deishtelim da, kayyma gufa shelim zimnin saggiin.
Begin dechol hahu ara dichnaan, veara demitzrayim, mechalla gufa umerakkev leh
500: Lizman zeir mikkol shear ara, uvegin lekayyma gufa avde da, veavde chanita da miggo umibbara. miggo deshavyan hahu mishcha al tabbura, vehu al betabbura lego veishteiv bemeoy, vekaim leh legufa miggo umibbara lezimnin saggiin.

Veyaakov hachi hava bekiyyuma degufa, vehachi itzterich. degufa deavahan ihu, vehava bekiyyuma begufa venafsha. kegavvna da leyosef, deihu dugema degufa, uvekiyyuma degufa venafsha hu. bekiyyuma degufa, dichtiv vayyachantu oto, bekiyyuma denafsha, dichtiv vayyisam baaron bemitzrayim.

Uteninan tere yudin ammay. ella, yosef natar leh berit letatta, venatir leh berit dilela, istallak mealma, itshavvi bitre arone, (atar) bearon letatta uvearon leela. aron dilela man ihu. ella, kema deat amer, (Yehoshua 6:6) hinne aron habberit adon kol haaretz, dearon dilela aron habberit ikre, deha la yarit leh ella man denatar berit, uvegin deyosef natar leh livrit, itshavve bitre arone.

Vayyisem baaron bemitzrayim, hachi hu vadday. ukera ochach raza ochora, deaf al gav denafkat nishmateh birshu ochora, itkashshar bishchinta. hada hu dichtiv, vayyisem baaron, leela uletatta, begin dehava tzaddik. dechol tzaddik yarit ara kaddisha illaa, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz nitzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen: salik sefer bereshit
