501: (Shemot 1:1) veelle shemot bene yisrael habbaim mitzrayma et yaakov ish uveto bau, (Daniel 12:3) vehammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia umatzdike harabbim kakkochavim leolam vaed vhammaskilim: illen innun demistakkelle beraza dechachmeta. (nusach acher yazhiru danetzatzeyn beraza dechachmeta) yazhiru: naharin, venotztzin beziva dechachmeta illaa. kezohar: nehiru unetzitzu denahara denafik meeden. veda ihu raza setima, deikre (Bereshit 10 34 1) rakia. beh kayaymin kochavaya umazzale shimsha vesihara, vechol innun butzinin dinhora.

Zohar dehay rakia nahir binhiru al ginta. veilana dechayye kayyaym bimtziut ginta. deanpoy chafyayn (davar acher aleh) (nusach acher al) kol innun diukenin veilanin uvusemin divginta, bemanin dechashran. (sefer acher vametalelayn) utetallin techoteh kol chevat bara. vechol tzippore shemaya yedurun techot innun anfin.

Zohar ibba deilana, yahiv chayyin lecholla. kiumeh lealam ulealme almin sitra achara la sharya beh, ella sitra dikdushsha. zakkaa chulakehon innun detaamin mineh, innun kayymin lealam ulealme almin. illen ikrun maskilim, vezakkaan chayyin behay alma, vechayyin bealma deate.

Zohar ilana da, zakfa leella leella. chamesh mea parse hillucheh, shittin ribbo ihu, bifshituteh. behay ilana, kayyeyma chad zohara, (zohar) kol gavvnin kayyaymin beh innun gavvnin salkin venachtin, la mityashve beducheta achara bar behahu ilana.

Kad nafke minneh leitchazaa bego zohar dela nahara, mityashshevan vela mityashshevan, kayyman vela kayyman, begin dela mityashshevan beatar achara. meilana da nafke teresar shevatin. demittechamman beh, veinnun nachtu behay zohar dela nahara, lego galuta demitzrayim, bechamma mashshiryayn illain, hada hu dichtiv veelle shemot bene yisrael vegomer.
Ribbi shimon patach, (Yechezkel 1) hayo haya devar Adonai, hayo haya tere
502: Zimni amay. vetu it leshaala, i yechezkel nevia mehemana hava, (Shemot 82 2) amay galle kol ma dechama, man demalka ail leh behechaleh it leh legalaa razin dechame. ella vadday yechezkel nevia mehemana hava, vechol ma dechama bimhemanuta ihu, uvirshuta dekudesha berich hu galle kol ma degalle, vecholla itzterich.

Amar rabbi shimon, man deragil lemisbal tzaara af al gav deate lefum shata tzaara, savil matlanoy, vela chayish, aval man dela ragil betztzaar, vahava kol yomoy betafnukin veidunin, veate leh tzaara, da ihu tzaara shelim, veal da itzterich lemivke.

Kacha yisrael, kad nachtu lemitzrayim, regilin betzaara havo, deha kol yomoy dehahu zakkaa avuhon betzaara hava, veal da savlu galuta kedka yaut. aval galuta devavel hahu hava tzaara shelim, hahu hava tzaara deillain vetattain bachan aleh.

Illain: dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:7) hen erellam tzaaku chutza vegomer. tattain: dichtiv, (Tehillim 137:1) al naharot bavel sham yashavnu vegomer kullehon bachu al galuta devavel. may tama. begin dahavo betafnuke malchin dichtiv, (Eicha 4:2) bene tziyyon hayekarim vegomer.

(8 Ditnan amar rabbi yitzchak, may dichtiv, 0 al heharim eshsha bechi unehe. ella, illen inun turaya ramya dealmin. uman inun turaya ramya, inun, bene tziyyon hayekarim hamesavelaaym bappaz) vehashsheta havo nachtin begaluta, berechayya al kadlehon videhon mehaddekan laachora. vechad alu begaluta bevavel, chashivu deha let lehu kiyyuma lealmin, deha kudesha berich hu shavik lon, vela yashgach behon lealmin.

Vetanenan, amar ribbi shimon, behahi shaata kara kudesha berich hu lechol pamalya dileh, vechol retichin kaddishin, vechol cheleh umashshiryayteh, veravrevanoy, vechol chela dishmayya, veamar lon, ma attun avdin hacha, uma bene rechimay begaluta devavel, veattun hacha, kumu chutu kullechon lebavel, vaana immechon. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 43:14) ko amar Adonai lemaanchem shillachti vavela vegomer. lemaanchem shillachti vavela, da kudesha berich hu. vehoradti varichim kulam, illen kol retichin umashiryayn illain.

Kad nachtu lebavel, itpattachu shemayya, vesharat ruach nevua kaddisha al yechezkel, vechama kol ma dechama, veamar lon leyisrael, ha marechon hacha, vechol chele shemayya uretichu, deatu lemedar benechon. la hemnuhu, ad deitzterich legallaa kol ma dechama, vaere kach, vaere kach. vei galle yattir, ma degalle kolla itzterich. kevan dechamu yisrael kach, chadu. vechad shamu millin mippumeh dichezkel, la chayyshu al galutehon kelal, deha yadu dekudesha berich hu la shavik lon. vechol ma degalle birshuta galle. (31 veamar rabbi shimon beh shaata chidu yisrael chedvavta shelemata besiyyata demarehon dehava immehon vechol chad minnayyhu al reuta delibbeh birchimuta sagya lemesar nafsheh al kedushata demarehon uvegin kach galle Yechezkel kol ma degalle)

Vetaninan bechol atar deyisrael galu, taman shechinta galta imhon, vehacha begaluta demitzrayim ma ketiv, veelle shemot bene yisrael vegomer. kevan dichtiv bene yisrael, mahu et yaakov, habbaim itto itzterich lememar. ella, elle shemot bene yisrael innun retichin umashshiryayn illain, denachtu im yaakov, bahade shechinta, begaluta demitzrayim

(Shemot 1:1) veelle shemot bene yisrael habbaim mitzrayma et yaakov ish uveto bau. ribbi chiyyay patach (Adonai 1 Shir HaShirim 4:8) itti millevanon kalla itti millevanon tavoi tashuri merosh amana merosh senir vechermon mimmeonot arayot meharere nemerim. hay kera al keneset yisrael ittemar, beshaata denafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, ukarivu letura desinay lekabbela orayyta, amar lah kudesha berich hu, itti millevanon: min hahu idduna illaa ka atat. kalla: shelemata, kehay sihara deishtelimat min shimsha bechol nehora unetzitzu,
503: Itti millevanon tavoi, begin lekabbela banayich orayyta.

Tashuri merosh amana, tashuri: kema deat amer (Shmuel 1 9:7) uteshura en lehavi. tekabbil takruveta al banayich. merosh amana: mereshita dealu bimhemanuta illaa, veamru (Shemot 24:7) kol asher dibber Adonai naase venishma, vahavu bematkela chada kemalachin illain, dehachi ketiv behu, (Tehillim 103:20) barchu Adonai malachav gibbore choach ose devaro lishmoa bekol devaro. keden kabbilat keneset yisrael teshura.

(Vayikra 192 1) merosh senir vechermon: da tura desinay, dekarivu legabbeh, veitattadu techoteh. dichtiv, (Shemot 19:17) vayyityatztzevu betachtit hahar. mimmeonot arayot: illen bene seir dekudesha berich hu zamin lon beorayyta, vela bau lekabbelah, meharere nemerim: illen beni yishmael. dichtiv, (Devarim 33:2) Adonai missinay ba vezarach misseir lamo hofia mehar paran veata merivvot kodesh.

May veata merivvot kodesh. detanenan, kad baa kudesha berich hu lemehav orayyta leyisrael, atu mashiryayn demalachin illain, patchu veamru, (Tehillim 8:2) Adonai adonenu ma addir shimcha bechol haaretz asher tena hodcha al hashshamayim, baan deyityehiv lon orayyta.

Amar lon kudesha berich hu, vechi it bechon mota, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 19:14) adam ki yamut beohel. (Devarim 21:22) vechi yihye veish chet mishpat mavet vehumat. chet it benayychu, vechi attun baan ledinin. it benayychu gezel. o geneva, dichtiv, (Shemot 20) lo tignov. it benayychu nashin dichtiv, (Shemot 20) lo tinaf. it benayychu shikra, dichtiv, (Shemot 20:13) lo taane vereacha ed shaker. it benayychu chemda, dichtiv, (Shemot 20:13) lo tachmod. ma attun baan orayyta. miyyad patchu veamru, Adonai adonenu ma addir shimcha bechol haaretz. veillu asher tena hodcha al hashshamayim la ketiv. veal da veata merivvot kodesh, keden mimino esh dat lamo.

Rabbi yose okim lehay kera, (Adonai 2) kad nachta shechinta begaluta demitzrayim. verabbi shimon amar, hay kera, al raza deyichuda dimhemanuta ittemar, itti millevanon kalla, kol amar ledibbur itti, begin deha (Bereshit 36 1) kol ate ledibbur, umedabbar lah vahadeh, lemeheve kachada bela piruda kelal. begin dekol ihu (Bereshit 247 2 25 1) kelal, dibbur ihu perat. veal da kelal itzterich lifrat, uferat itzterich lichlal. deha let kol belo dibbur, velet dibbur belo kol. veal da itti millevanon kalla vegomer, deikara detarvayyhu millevanon ka atyayn.

Tashuri merosh amana: da ihu garon, demittamman nafka rucha leashlema kolla, (nusach acher kullah) meraza dilvanon satim veganiz. merosh senir vechermon: da ihi lishana resha veemtzaita, dimchattecha ledibbur. mimmeonot arayot: illen innun shinayim. meharere nemerim: illen innun sifvavn, shelimu deishtelim behu dibbur.

Veelle shemot bene yisrael. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Mishlei 23:6) al tilcham et lechem ra ayin veal titav lematammotav. al tilcham et lechem ra ayin, begin denahama o hanaa dehahu bar nash dehavy ra ayin, lav ihu keday lemechal uleithani minnih. dei kad nachtu yisrael lemitzrayim, la yitamun nahama demitzrae, la ishtevaku begaluta, vela yeikun lon mitzrae.

Amar leh ribbi yitzchak, veha gezera itgezar. amar leh, kolla ihu kedka yaut, deha la itgezar bemitzrayim davvka, deha la ketiv (Bereshit 15:13) ki ger yihye zaracha beeretz mitzrayim, ella beeretz lo lahem, vaafillu beara achara.

Amar Rabbi yitzchak, man deihu baal nefesh, (sefer acher lo yykal im bar nash) demechleh yattir mishshear bene nasha, o man dehu azil batar meoy, i ira behahu ra ayin, yechus garmeh vela yechul minnahama dileh, delet nahama bisha bealma, bar mehahu lechem ra ayin, ma ketiv (Bereshit 43:32) ki lo yuchelun hammitzrim leechol et haivrim lechem ki toeva hi lemitzrayim, ha lach lechem ra ayin,
Telata innun dedachyayn shechinta mealma, vegarmin, dediureh dekudesha berich hu la have bealma, uveni nasha tzavvchin vela ishtema kallehon. veillen innun: man
504: Deshachiv bannidda, begin delet misavu takkif bealma bar misseavu denidda. misavu denidda kashya mikkol misavu dealma, isteav ihu, vechol demitkarvin bahadeh yistaavun immeh, bechol atar deazlin itdachyay shechinta min kamayyhu.

Velo od, ella degarim marin bishin al garmeh, veal hahu zara deyolid, dechevan deyikrav bar nash legabbe nidda, hahu misavu dalig aloy, veyishtaar bechol shayyfin dileh, zara deyolid behahu shaata, (sefer acher misavu) mashchin aloy ruach misavu. vechol yomoy yehe bimsaavu, deha binyana visoda dileh ihu bimsaavu rav vetakkif mikkol mesaava dealma, demiyyad dekariv bar nash legabbe nidda, hahu misavu dalig aloy, dichtiv, (Vayikra 15:24) utehi niddatah alav.

Man deshachiv bevat el nechar, deail berit kodesh veat kayyayma birshu achara, dichtiv, (Malachi 2:11) uvaal bat el nechar. vetanenan, let kina kame kudesha berich hu, bar kina divrit kaddisha, deihu kayyayma dishma kaddisha, veraza dimhemanuta. ma ketiv (Bamidbar 25:1) vayyachel haam liznot el benot moav miyyad vayyichar af Adonai beyisrael.

Reshshe amma deyadu velo michu bidayyhu, itanshu bekadmita, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 25:4) kach et kol rashe haam vehoka otam laAdonai neged hashshamesh. ribbi abba amar, may neged hashshamesh. neged habberit deikre shemesh, vaaleh ittemar (tehillim 84) ki shemesh umagen Adonai elohim. shemesh umagen (224 2): da berit kaddisha. ma shemesh zarach veanhir al alma, uf hachi berit kaddisha zarach veanhir gufa debar nash. magen: ma magen ihu leaggana aleh debar nash, uf hachi berit kaddisha magen aleh debar nash, uman denatir leh, let nizka bealma, deyachil lemikrav bahadeh veda hu neged hashshamesh.

Reshe amma, yittafsun bechol dara vedara bechova da, i yadin vela mekanin leh. begin dechova da alayyhu, lekanaa leh lekudesha berich hu behay berit, man deail kedusha da birshuta achara, aleh ketiv (Shemot 20:Adonai) lo yihye lecha elohim acherim al panay. lo tishtachave lahem velo taavdem ki anochi Adonai elohecha el kanna vecholla kina chada. veal da itdachyay shechinta mikameh. man dimshakker bivrit kaddisha dechatim bivsareh debar nash, keillu meshakker bishma dekudesha berich hu, man dimshakker chotama demalka, meshakker beh bemalka, let leh chulaka beelaha deyisrael, i la bechela detiuveta tadir. (sefer acher yattir)

Rabbi yose patach veamar, (Shmuel 1 12:9) vayyishkechu et Adonai elohehem vegomer, vayaazvu et Adonai. may vayyishkechu vayaazvu. dedachu minnayyhu berit kayayma kaddisha, havo gazrin vela parin, ad deatat devora unedivat behay lechol yisrael kemma dichtiv, (Shoftim Adonai:2) bifroa peraot beyisrael behitnaddev am barachu Adonai.
Man dekatil benoy, hahu obbara demitabbera itteteh, vegarim lekatala leh bimaha, desatir binyayna dekudesha berich hu veumanuta dileh. it man dekatil bar nash. vehay kattil benoy.

Telata bishin avid dechol alma la yachil lemisbal, veal da alma mitmogga zeer zeer, velo yedia, vekudesha berich hu istalik mealma, vecharba vechafna umotana atyayn al alma. veillen innun: katil benoy, satir binyayna demalka. dache shechinta, deazla umeshatteta bealma, vela ashkachat nayycha. veal (da) illen, rucha (sefer acher ruchin) dekudesha (avid) bachya. vealma itdan bechol hane dinin. vavy lehahu bar nash, vavy leh, tav leh dela yitbere bealma.

Zakkain innun yisrael, deaf al gav dahavu begaluta demitzrayim, istamaru mikkol hane telata, minnidda, umibbat el nichar, umikkettol zara, veishtaddalu befarhesya befirya ureviyya. deaf al gav digzera itgazrat (Shemot 1:22) kol habben hayyillod hayyeora tashlichuhu, la ishtechach benehon man dekatil ubbara bimaha deitteta, kol shekken levatar. uvizchuta da nafku yisrael min galuta.
505: Dichtiv, (Shemot 38:8) vayyaash et hakkiyyor nechoshet veet kanno nechoshot bemarot hatztzovot. mippene ma zachu nashin lehay, begin deistamaru garmayyhu begaluta demitzrayim, dilvatar deitdachyayn havo atyayn mitkashshetan umistakkelan bammara bivalehon, umeorran lon befirya ureviyya.

Mibbat el nechar, dichtiv, (Shemot 12:41) yatzu kol tzivot Adonai vegomer. uchetiv (Tehillim 122:4) shivte yah edut leyisrael. edut leyisrael vadday. veelle shemot beni yisrael. shivte beni yisrael. dabber el bene yisrael.

Vei tema veha ketiv vehu ben ish mitzri. ha vadday chad hava, ufirsemo kera, dichtiv, (Vayikra 24:11) vehu ben ish mitzri vegomer veshem immo shelomit bat divri lematte dan. pirya verivya dichtiv, (Shemot 1:7) uvene yisrael paru vayyishretzu vayyirbu vegomer. umikkol hane istamaru yisrael. bene yisrael (7 1) alu, bene yisrael nafku, hada hu dichtiv veelle shemot beni yisrael vegomer.

Veelle shemot bene yisrael. ribbi elazar veribbi yose havo azle beorcha, ad dahavo azle, amar ribbi elazar leribbi yose, aftach pumach, veyinharun milach amar leh nicha kameh demar, deeshal milla chada dekashya li, (achore daf ze) ha shemana mibbutzina kaddisha, dehava amar, veelle shemot beni yisrael, yisrael sava. kol innun chelin umashreyayn dehavo nachtin legaluta bahade yaakov, dichtiv, et yaakov. mahu dichtiv ish uveto bau. amar leh, vadday hachi hu. ella ha tanenan, kol dimkabbel meachara, ihu beta mehahu deyahiv, veal da ish uveto bau.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Melachim 1 9:1) vayhi kechallot shelomo livnot et bet Adonai veet bet hammelech vegomer. vechi kevan deamar et bet Adonai, mahu veet bet hammelech, i begin shelomo ittemar, lav hachi, ella et bet Adonai da bet hammikdash, veet bet hammelech da kodesh hakkodashim.

Bet Adonai deihu bet hammikdash kegon: azarot uleshachot uvet haulam vehaddevir, da bet hammikdash, vadday ikre bet Adonai. bet hammelech: da kodesh hakkadashim, deihu penimaa decholla, hammelech setam. melech da, af al gav deihu melech illaa, ihu nukeba legabbe nekuda illaa, setima decholla. veaf al gav deihu nukeba, ihu dechura legabbe melech diltatta, uvegin kach kolla kegavvna da veal da, tattae, beraza da ketiv behu, ish uveto bau.

Veelle shemot, ribbi (elazar) yose patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 4:12) gan naul achoti challa gal naul mayan chatum. gan naul: da keneset yisrael shehi gan naul. deamar ribbi elazar, ma haggan hazze tzarich lishmor, lador, ulehashkot, velizmor. kach keneset yisrael, tzericha lador, velishmor, ulehashkot, velizmor, venikret gan, venikret kerm, ma hakkerem hazze tzarich lador ulehashkot velizmor velachpor, kach yisrael, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu Adonai:7) ki kerem Adonai tzevaot bet yisrael uchetiv, (Yeshayahu Adonai:7) vayazkehu vaysakkelehu vegomer.

Tosefta matnitin: amar ribbi shimon, anan patchin enana chaman, galgalle retichata kaddishata natlin bematlanoy, vekal shirata besima leudenin, yae lelibba, salleka venachta, azla vela natla, mizdazein elef alfin, veribbo rivvan ufatchin shirata milra leella.

Lekal neimuta hahu, kayymin man dekayymin, umitkannefin bichnufeya lesitra dimina, arba mea vechamshin alfin mare deayynin. chamman vela chamman, kayymin bekiyyumehon. teren sitrin ochoranin itchavvevru (sefer acher atechazerav) beginehon. ulesitra dismala matan vechamshin alfin.

Innun marehon divava, meyabbevin umeyallelin meatar bet motvehon, patchin bedina umesayyeymin bedina. meyabbevin tinyaynut, vedina yativ, vesifrin petichu. beh shaata, salik mareh dedina, dekaim alehon, veyativ bechuresayyay dedina, veshirata ishtechach, ad la tistayyaym dina
Sacharan mare deayynin dilsitra yemina, veimmehon
506: Tamnesar alfin acharanin takin, vela meyabbevin vela meyallelin (sefer acher lo maylaleyn velo meyabbevin) patchin shirata, mizdazean matan vechamshin alfin mare divava.

Taka tinyaynut vela meyabbevin (sefer acher velo meyabbevin velo maylaleyn) natil patrona, mehahu kuresayyay veyativ bechuresayyay devavtranuta. beh zimna hava (nusach acher hu) midkar shema kaddisha illaa rabba, divhahu shema chayyim lecholla.

Patach veamar zimna chada yod hei vav hei (sefer acher yod hei vav hei) kema deat amer (Shemot 34:5) vayyikra veshem Adonai. patchin kikadmeta mare galgalle kaddishin. veelef alfin, veribbo rivvan, veamre shirata, meshabbechin veamrin, berich yekara de meatar bet shechinteh.

Atya hahu ginta, dehavat (nusach acher deihi) temira bematan vechamshin almin, hu shechinta yekara bezivah, denafik mizziva leziva, vezivah nagid mineh, led sitrin reshin, lekadmae (sefer acher lekayyeyma), mehahu ziva nafak (sefer acher itmeshach) lechullehu deinnun letatta, vehahi ikre ginta deeden.

Patach tinyaynut hahu sava, patrona decholla umidkar shemeh yod hei vav hei, vechullehu patche bitlesar mechilan derachame. man chame kol illen takkifin, ramin deramin, takkifin detakkifin, retichin kaddishin, ushemaya, vechol chelehon, mizdazein umitchalchelan beemata sagya, meshabbechan shema kaddisha, veamrin shirata. zakkain innun nishmathon detzaddikayyay, deinnun behahu idduna, veyadin da, al hay ittemar (Yirmeyahu 10:7) mi lo yiraacha melech haggoyim ki lecha yaata vegomer. (ad kan tosefta)

Amar ribbi shimon, kad nachtat shechinta lemitzrayim, nachtat chayya chada, dishmah yisrael, bediyyukena dehahu sava, vearbein uteren shammashin kaddishin immeh, vechol chad vechad at kaddisha immeh, mishshema kaddisha, vechullehu nachtan im yaakov lemitzrayim, hada hu dichtiv, veelle shemot bene yisrael habbaim mitzrayma et yaakov. amar ribbi yitzchak, mimmashma dekaamar bene yisrael, veachar kach et yaakov, velo neemar itto.

Shaal ribbi yehuda leribbi elazar berabbi shimon, (amar leh) kevan deshamat meavuch, parashat veelle shemot beraza illaa, may kaamar ish uveto bau. amar leh, hahu milla dehava amar abba, innun havu malachin illain, deinnun leella al tattae minhon, hayeynu dichtiv ish uveto bau, vehachi amar abba, kol innun malachin divdarga illaa, ikrun guverin ducherin, veinnun divdarga tattaa minhon, itkerun (navekabetaa) bayit, deitteta nukeba dimkabbela min dechura.

Ribbi yitzchak hava kaim kameh deribbi elazar bar ribbi shimon, amar leh shechinta nachtat lemitzrayim im yaakov. amar leh vela, veha ketiv (Bereshit 46:4) anochi ered immecha. amar leh ta chaze, shechinta nachtat lemitzrayim et yaakov veshit mea alfin retichin kaddishin (acharanin) immah, vehayeynu dichtiv keshesh meot elef ragli, tanenan shit mea alfin retichin kaddishin nachtu im yaakov lemitzrayim, vechullehu seliku mittamman, kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 12:37) vayyisu bene yisrael merameses sukkota keshesh meot elef ragli vegomer. shesh meot lo neemar, ella keshesh meot, kegavvna denafku illen, kach nafku illen.

Veta chaze raza demilla, beidana denafku illen retichin kaddishin, mashshiryayta kaddishata, chamu yisrael veyadu, dahavu mitakkevin beginehon, vechullehu behilu deavdu yisrael, beginehon hava, vehayeynu dichtiv, (Shemot 12:39) velo yachlu lehitmahmeah, hava leh lememar vela ratzu lehitmahmeah aval la ketiv ella velo yachlu. veityeydau (70 vaaytenadea) mammash, dechullehu bene yisrael, havu beni yisrael dirkia, vehayeynu dichtiv, bene yisrael habbaim mitzrayma et yaakov, veal da la neemar veelle shemot bene yisrael habbaim mitzrayma itto, ella veelle shemot bene yisrael habbaim mitzrayma et yaakov, habbaim mitzrayma bekadmita veim mi, et yaakov.

Amar ribbi yehuda, (nusach acher rabbi yitzchak nusach acher rabbi yose) kal vachomer, uma kad ishteziv yaakov millavan, ketiv, (Bereshit 32:2) veyaakov halach ledarko vayyifgeu vo malache elohim. kad nachat begaluta, vekudesha berich hu amar, anochi ered immecha mitzrayma,
507: Lav dina, hoil ufatrona nachta deyyichtun shammashoy immeh, hayeynu dichtiv habbaim mitzrayma et yaakov. ribbi yaakov dichfar chanan amar mishshemeh der abba, man innun beni yisrael dehacha. innun deitkerun bene yisrael mammash.

Rabbi abba patach veamar, (Bereshit 58 2) (Tehillim 46:9) lechu chazu mifalot Adonai asher sam shamot baaretz. al tikre shammot. ella shemot. veazla ha keha deamar Rabbi chiyyay, kegavvna dirkia, avad kudesha berich hu beara birkia it shemahan kaddishin, beara it shemahan kaddishin.

Amar ribbi yehuda (nusach acher rabbi yose) behahu yoma denachat yaakov lemitzrayim, nachtu immeh shittin ribbo demalache illae. Rabbi yehuda patach, (Shir HaShirim 3:7) hinne mittato shellishlomo shishshim gibborim saviv vegomer kuzemitin diglifin bekandita (sefer acher bakeladeytea), sacharan beducheteh kuzemitin bishviaa, gelifin bishtitaa, hada hu dichtiv, shishshim gibborim saviv lah.

Hinne mittato: da ihi (Bereshit 225) shechinta. shellishlomo: malka dishlama dileh. shishshim gibborim saviv lah: illen innun shittin ribbo demalache illae, deinnun mechela dishchinta, denachtat im yaakov lemitzrayim. miggibbore yisrael: yisrael dilella, hada hu dichtiv veelle shemot beni yisrael vegomer, ish uveto bau: innun venimusehon.

Rabbi chiyyay hava azil meusha lelud, vahava rachiv al chamara, vahava Rabbi yose immeh, nachit Rabbi chiyyay, veshakleh bidoy ler yose, amar leh, i beni alma yadin yekara saggia deyaakov, beshata deamar leh kudesha berich hu, anochi ered immecha mitzrayma, havu melachache afra, telat parse kariv lekivreh, dehachi mefarshe marana ravreve alma, marehon dematnita, ketiv (Shemot 18:7) vayyetze moshe likrat chotno, aharon chama lemoshe denafak, venafak immeh, veelazar unesie vesave nafku immeh, rashe avahan, umeare kenishta, vechol yisrael nafku immehon, ishtakkechu dechol yisrael kullehu, nafku lekavleh deyitro, man chama lemoshe denafik vela yippuk, leaharon uleravreve denafke, vela yippuk. ishtechach, divgin moshe nafku kulehon. uma, i begin moshe kach, begin kudesha berich hu, kad amar anochi ered immecha mitzrayma, al achat kamma vechamma.

Ad dahavu azle, paga behu Rabbi abba. amar ribbi yose, ha shechinta hacha, dechad mimarehon dematnitin immana. amar Rabbi abba, bemay askittu. amar ribbi yose, behay kera, dichtiv anochi ered immecha mitzrayma vegomer. kad nachat yaakov lemitzrayim, dichtiv, veelle shemot bene yisrael habbaim mitzrayma, at olif, dechullehu nachtu im yaakov lemitzrayim.

Amar leh Rabbi abba, veda lechud havat. patach veamar (Yechezkel 1:3) hayo haya devar Adonai el yechezkel ben buzi hakkohen beeretz kasdim al nehar kevar. telat pelugetan hacha. chada, detanenan, en shechina shora bechutza laaretz. vachada, dela hava meheman kemmoshe, dichtiv beh, (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu, vehu, galle ufarsem kol ginzayyay demalka. vachada, deitchaze keman dela shelim bedateh.

Ella hachi asikna bematnita dilan, chas veshalom deha yechezkel nevia shelema hava, uvirshuta dekudesha berich hu galle kol ma degalle. vechullehu itzterich digalle vifarsem, al chad teren mimma degalle, dehachi tenan, man deragil lemisbal tzaara vechulei. (ayyen leel 4 1 2 shura 4 74 45 degalle) vecholla itzterich, umealmin la shavik kudesha berich hu leyisrael begaluta, ad dehava ate lemedar dioreh immehon, kol shekken beyaakov, dehava nachit begaluta, vekudesha berich hu ushechinteh, vekaddishin illain, (vetattain) uretichin, denachtu kullehu im yaakov, hada hu dichtiv habbaim mitzrayma et yaakov.

Davar acher Rabbi abba patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 4:8) itti millevanon kalla itti millevanon tavoi. ta chaze, vavy lon bene nasha dela yadin, vela mashgichin befulechana demarehon, detanya amar ribbi yitzchak, bechol yoma veyoma bat kol nafkat mittura dechorev, veamar, vavy lon livne nasha mippulechana demarehon, vavy lon livne nasha meelbonah
508: Deorayyta. deamar Rabbi yehuda, kol man deishtaddal beorayyta behay alma, umesaggel ovadin tavin yarit alma shelema. vechol man dela ishtaddal beorayyta behay alma, vela avid ovadin tavin, la yarit la hay vela hay. veha tenan, it man deyarit almeh kefum atreh, uchefum ma dechaze leh. amar ribbi yitzchak, la tenan, ella man delet leh ovadin tavin kelal.

Amar ribbi yehuda, ilmale havo yadin beni nasha, rechimuta derachim kudesha berich hu leyisrael, havo shaagin kichfirayya lemirdaf avatreh. detanya, beshaata denachat yaakov lemitzrayim, kara kudesha berich hu lepamalya dileh amar lehon, kullechon chutu lemitzrayim, vaana echut immechon. amra shechinta ribbona dealma, it tzevaot belo malka, amar lah, itti millevanon kalla, millevanon: meatra deeden, dimlubban bechol ovadoy. kalla: da shechinta, dehi kalla bechuppa. veazla ha keha detanya amar ribbi yehuda, may dichtiv, (Bamidbar 7:1) vayhi beyom kallot moshe, kallat ketiv, beyoma dealat kalla lachuppa, ushechinta da hi kalla.

Itti millevanon tavoi, meatar be makdesha dilella. tashuri merosh amana, meresha deman. merashehon divni mehemanuta. uman ninhu. yaakov uvenoy. merosh senir vechermon, deinnun atidin lekabbela orayyta dili, mittura dechermon, uleaggana alayyhu begalutehon. mimmeonot arayot: illen innun ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, (nusach acher bene nasha dimhemnuta) dedamyayn learyavavta unemerin, dimannin lehon bechol pulechana dekashyu.

Rabbi abba amar, itti millevanon kalla vegomer. vechi millevanon atat, vahalo lallevanon ola. ella amar ribbi abba, beshaata denachtat shechinta lemitzrayim, nachtu bahadah shittin ribbo shel malache hasharet, vekudesha berich hu bekadmita hada hu dichtiv, (Micha 2:13) vayyaavor malkam lifnehem vaAdonai berosham.

Rabbi yitzchak amar, itti millevanon kalla, da ihi shechinta. itti millevanon tavoi, meatar be makdesha dilella. tashuri merosh amana, meatar be makdesha dilella, umeatar be makdesha diltatta deamar Rabbi yehuda, meolam lo zaza shechinta mikkotle demaarva, deve makdesha, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:9) hinne ze omed achar katlenu. vehu rosh amana lechol alma. merosh senir vechermon meatra deorayyta nafkat lealma, velamma. leaggana al yisrael, mimmeonot arayot: illen ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. Rabbi yudan omer, mimmeonot arayot: illen innun talmide chachamim, deaske beorayyta bimonot hammidrashot, uvevatte kenesiyyot, deinnun aryavan unemerim beorayyta.

Rabbi chiyyay hava yativ kameh derabbi shimon, amar leh, ma chamat orayyta lemimne benoy deyaakov, deinnun teresar bekadmita, ulevatar ken shivim dichtiv, (Bereshit 46:27) kol hannefesh levet yaakov habbaa mitzrayma shivim. umay tama shivim vela yattir. amar le, lekabbel 70 umin, deinun bealma, veinun havu uma yechidaa lekabbel kulhon.

Vetu amar le, ta chaze, kalditin denaharin (guverin) anafin yatvin bematlenehon, (nusach acher bametavelahevan) memanan al shivin amamin, nafkin mitteresar gelifin keturin deistacharan bemattalnehon, lemitkelan learba ruche alma, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 32:8) yatztzev gevulot ammim lemispar bene yisrael. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Zecharya 2:10) ki kearba ruchot hashshamayim perasti etchem, leachazaa deinnun kayymin begin yisrael. bearba la neemar, ella kearba. kema dei efshar lealma belo arba ruchot kach i efshar lealma belo yisrael.

(Shemot 1:8) vayyakam melech chadash. Rabbi abba patach (Yeshayahu 32:20) ashrechem zore al kol mayim meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor, zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu itree behu mikkol shear ammin, vekariv lon legabbeh, dichtiv, (Devarim 14:2) uvecha bachar Adonai lihyot lo leam segula vegomer, uchetiv (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato, yisrael mitdabbekin beh bekudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem
509: Veal da zakkain innun kameh, begin deinnun zarin al kol mayim. may al kol mayim. dezarin litzdaka. uman dezara litzdaka, ketiv beh (tehillim 57) (hada hu dichtiv, 1 ki gadol ad shamayim al kol mayim) ihu have, uman ihu meal shamayim. (Vayikra 16 amud alef 64 2) da alma deate. veyisrael zare zara al kol mayim.

Besifra derav yeva sava hachi amar, ketiv (Daniel 4:14) begizrat irin pitgama umemar kaddishin sheelta, kol dinin dehay alma, vechol gizrin, vechol sheeltin, kullehu kayyme bechad hechala, detamman amud bet sanhedrin meayyeynin bedinin dealma. vehahu hechala ikre hechol (pikkude 251 amud alef) zechuta, begin, dechad dayynin dina, mehappechin bizchuta devar nash bekadmita.

Ma delav hachi, bedarga dehahu sitra achara, detamman ihu atar deikre (265 1) chova, begin dechol ovadoy dehahu atar, denachash eshet zenunim, la ihu ella limhappecha bechova debar nash, ulemilshan avda lemareh.

Innun dehechla dezchuta, ikrun mayim metukim, mayim tzelulin. innun dehechala dechova, ikrun mayin meririn, (Bamidbar Adonai:18) me hammarim hameararim. behahu hechala dizchuta, la kayyme illen telat (Bereshit 181 1): bene, chayye, umezone. velav behahu atar (266 1) dechova, la bemayim metikan utzelilan, velav bemayim meririn melattetin.

Veal da, yisrael zare al kol mayim, zara kaddisha deolidu al kol mayim, ihu, deha lav nachon zara dilhon ella leella. veal da ukemuha mikkol makom, beni chayye umezone, lav bizchuta talya milleta, ella bemazzala kaddisha talya milleta, vaatar da al kol mayya ihu.

Meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor, dela it lon behahu sitra bisha kelum, umeshadderan minnayyhu kol chulakin bishin, umitdabbekin behahu sitra tava, dechol kedushin (Bereshit 166 2) illain, shor vachamor kad mizdavvevgan kachada, teren pigin bishin innun lealma. shor: sitra dedina kashya ihu, veitdabbekuta distar kaddisha ihu. chamor: kad izdevavg bahadeh, deihu missitra achara, teren pigin bishin innun lealma.

Veal da, shimon tukefa dedina kashya hava beh, vechad mizdavvevgan kachada, la yachil alma lemisbal, uvegin kach, (Devarim 22:10) lo tacharosh beshor uvachamor yachdav. veal da, shadar yaakov leesav milla da, dichtiv, (Bereshit 32:6) vayhi li shor vachamor. vei lav demaich yaakov garmeh, dechilu sagya nafal beh beesav.

Vayyakam melech chadash al mitzrayim. besifra derav hamenuna sava hachi ittemar, may dichtiv vayyakam melech chadash al mitzrayim, ta chaze, kol ammin dealma, vechol malchin dealma, la ittekafu beshuletanihon, ella beginayyhu deyisrael, mitzrayim la havo shaltin al kol alma, ad deatu yisrael, vealu tamman begaluta, keden ittakafu al shear (beshallach 79 1) ammin dealma. bavel la ittakafu al kol ammin dealma, ella begin deyisrael dillehevyayn begalutehon. edom la ittakafu al kol ammin dealma ella beginehon deyisrael, dillehevyayn begalutehon. deha ammin illen beshifluta havo bishar ammin, umeichin havo mikkullehu, uvegin yisrael ittakafu.

Mitzrayim: dichtiv, (Shemot 20:2) mibbet avadim. avadim ikrun mammash, deha (Shemot 17 amud alef) mitzrayim beshifluta dishar ammin havo. bavel: dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 23:13) hen eretz kasdim ze haam lo haya. edom: dichtiv, (ovadya 1) hinne katon netatticha baggoyim bazuy atta meod.

Vechullehu la natlu tukepa ella beginehon deyisrael. dechad yisrael begalutehon miyyad mittakfe al kol shear ammin dealma. may tama, begin deyisrael innun bilchodayyhu, lokovel kol (16 1) ammin dealma. kad alu yisrael begaluta demitzrayim, miyyad hava kima lemitzrayim, veittakaf shuletanuta dilhon leella al kol shear ammin, dichtiv vayyakam melech chadash al mitzrayim, vayyakam: kima hava lon, deittakaf vekam hahu memana shuletana demitzrayim, veityeyhiv leh tukepa veshultanuta, al kol memanan dishar ammin deha bekadmita it shuletanuta lehahu memana dilella, ulevatar leamma dileh
510: Diltatta. uvegin kach, vayyakam melech chadash al mitzrayim. da hu memana dilhon, chadash hava, dead yoma haden la hava leh shuletana al shear ammin, vehashsheta ittekam leshaltaa al kol shear ammin dealma, ucheden itkayyaym (Mishlei 30:22) tachat shalosh ragza eretz tachat eved ki yimloch.

Rabbi chiyyay amar, telatin yomin ad la yete tukepa leamma beara, o ad la tete teviru leamma beara, machrize bealma hahu milla, ulezimnin deittemsar hahu milla befuma deravye, ulezimnin leinun bene nasha delet behu data ulezimnin masar hahu milla itmesar befuma deofe umachrize bealma, velet man deyishgach behu. kad amma zakkain, itmesar hahu milla leinun reshin zakkain dealma, begin deyodiu lon, vituvun lemarehon, vechad lav innun zakkain, have kidkamran.

Rabbi elazar, hava yativ yoma chad attara delud, vahava yativ immeh ribbi abba, veribbi yehuda, veribbi yose. amar ribbi yose ema lechu, ma dechamit yoma da. betzafra kamet binhora, chamit chad ofa, dehava tais zakaf leella telat zimne, umaich chad, vahava amar, illae illae, beyoma da tase (sefer acher dakkikin) rekiin (limina) telat memanan zakfin shaltanin al ara, chad yativ dela yativ, aberu leh benura dedalik, meabberin kayyaymeh, meabberin shultaneh, telat samchin shallitin illain, kayymin al alma.

Ramena lehahu ofa kalla, amena leh ofa ofa, ema li telat dekayymin memanan, vechad demabberin shultaneh, man innun. rama li telat girin illen miggadfa yemina, veden chad missemala, (sefer acher vamegadepaa semala chad) vela yadana may remiza.

Nasiv lehu ribbi elazar, nachet leho linchiroy, nafak dama minnechiroy. amar, vadday telat shaltane ammin kayymin beromi beara, uzeminin lemebad gizrin bishin leyisrael, missitra deromae. nasiv hahu gira demiggadfa semala, arach, venafak eshshata uchama minneh, amar shultana demitzrae adiu vezammin chad malka deromae, leavera bechol ara (sefer acher demitzrayim), (sefer acher vezammin chad malka meinnun telat dekaamaran lemishlat bah vasetayr binyana uvene bah binyana) ulemannaa bemitzrayim ravreve terisin, vesatir binyan, uvani setirin. rama lon Rabbi elazar leara, naflu illen telat al chad demistera semala.

Ad dehavu yatve, abar chad yenoka, vahava kare (Yeshayahu 19:1) massa mitzrayim hinne Adonai rochev al av kal uva mitzrayim. abar tinyayna chavreh, veamar, veeretz mitzrayim tihye shemama. abar telitaa chavreh, veamar, veavda chachmat mitzrayim. chamu hahu gira degadfa semala deittokad, utelat acharanin dehavu aleh la ittokdan.

Amar ribbi elazar, hay deofa, vehay dedardeke kolla hu chad, vecholla nevua illaa hu, (sefer acher kolla ihu beraza dechachmeta) uvaa kudesha berich hu leachazaa lan, sitre illae dehu avid, hada hu dichtiv, (Amos 3:7) ki lo yaase Adonai elohim davar ki im gala sodo el avadav hanneviim.

Vechakkime adife minnevie bechol zeman, deha linvie lezimnin sharat alayyhu ruach kudesha, ulezimnin la, vechakkimin la ade minnehon ruach kudesha afilu riga chada, (zeer) deyadin ma di leella vetatta, vela bau legallaa. amar ribbi yose (yehuda) kolla chachmeta, vechachmeta 204 elazar yattir mikkullehu. ribbi abba amar, ilmale la havo chakkimin, la havo yaddein bene nasha, mahu orayyta, uma pikkudoy demare alma, vela itparsha rucha divne nasha, merucha divira.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, kad ayyte kudesha berich hu dina al amma, bekadmita avid dina, behahu memana demmana alayyhu leella, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 24:21) yifkod Adonai al tzeva hammarom bammarom veal malche haadama al haadama.
Bemay dina ittedan hahu memana dilella. aberu leh behahu nehar dinur denagid venafik, ucheden adiu hahu shuletanuta dileh, umiyyad machrize aleh birkia, shuletanuta dimmana pelanya adiu minneh
511: Ad demate hahu kalla bechol innun rekiin ad demate beinun deshaltin behay alma, venafik kala veachriz bechol alma, ad demate leofe velinoke, uleinun tippeshin divne nasha dela yadin.

Vayyakam melech chadash. ribbi chiyyay amar, melech chadash, chadash mammash hava. ribbi yose amar dehava mechaddesh gezerin, dela chidesh malka achara mikkadmat dena. asher lo yada et yosef. kol hahu tivu, deavad yosef beara demitzrayim, dichtiv, (Bereshit 47:14) vayyave yosef et kol hakkesef beta faro. vekiyyem lon bishni kafna, kol hay la dachir, veavid garmeh dela yada beh.

Ribbi yose veribbi yehuda, havo yatvi velaan beorayyta kameh derabbi shimon, amar ribbi yehuda, hay dichtiv vayyakam melech chadash al mitzrayim, vetanenan, deihu kam miggarmeh, ma dehava shafal, kam, vela itchaze lemalka, uveutera kam. amar ribbi shimon, kolla hachi hu, kegavvna deachashverosh dela itchaze lemalka, vekam miggarmeh, vekam beutera, uvaa leovada leyisrael mealma, uf hacha, hay la itchaze lemalka, vekam migarmeh, uvaa leovada leyisrael mealma, dichtiv vayyomer el ammo vegomer, hava nitchakkema lo vegomer, vechad hava kam malka leella, kam malka letatta.

Ribbi elazar veribbi abba veribbi yose, havo azle mitteverya letzippori, ad dahavu azle, paga behu chad yudai, patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 19:1) massa mitzrayim hinne Adonai rochev al av kal uva mitzrayim venau elile mitzrayim mippanav. ta chaze, kol malchin dealma, vechol ammin dealma, la chashive kelum kame kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Daniel 4:32) vechol dayyeyre ara kela chashivin uchemitzbeye avid bechel shemayya. vehacha bemitzrayim, af al gav dechol innun gevuran, vedara meromma gale kudesha berich hu bemitzrayim, ma ketiv hinne Adonai rochev al av kal uva mitzrayim. may shena, bechol ammin dealma, dela hava hachi, deha kudesha berich hu gazar gezera veitavid, vehacha ihu ata, dichtiv uva mitzrayim. uchetiv, (Shemot 12:12) veavarti veeretz mitzrayim vegomer ani Adonai.

Ella, begin demalka hava ate, leappaka lematronita dahavavt tamman. uvegin yekara dematronita hava ate. veal da hava kudesha berich hu bae bikarah, veate legabbah laakkama lah, ulemehav lah yeda, ulezakfa lah, kema dezammin kudesha berich hu lemebad besof galuta deedom.

Amar ribbi yesa, i hachi, divgin dematronita hava, ha begaluta devavel, matronita tamman havat, amay la hava kach. amar leh, ha tanenan, dechattaa garam, denatlu nashim nachriyyot, veailu berit kayyayma kaddisha birshuta achara. uvegin kach itavidu minnehon nissin, veatvavn, deitchaze lemebad lehu, ma dela hava hachi begaluta demitzrayim, dechullehu havo shivte yah, bene yisrael (4 1) alu, bene yisrael nafku.

Begaluta deedom, bae kudesha berich hu leityakkera bealma, ulemete ihu leakkama lematronita, ulenaara lah meafra. vavy leman diara tamman kameh, beshaata deyema (Yeshayahu 52:2) hitnaari meafar kumi shevi yerushalayim hitpattechi mosre tzavvarech. man hu malka veamma deyekum kameh.

(Yeshayahu 19:1) venau elile mitzrayim mippanav, elile mitzrayim, lav al avanin veain ittemar, ella al kol innun dargin memanan illain, veal innun pulechanin tattain dilhon. uvechol atar degalu yisrael, kudesha berich hu bae alayyhu, veitkavil meinun ammin.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (yeshaya 52) cho amar Adonai mitzrayim yarad ammi varishona lagur sham veashshur beefes ashako tureama deitream kudesha berich hu al ashshur, veamar, chamu ma aved li ashshur, deha mitzrayim daana avadit behu kol innun dinin, veammi (inun) nachtu tamman, ledayyayra benehon, vekibbelum mitzrae benayyhu, veyahavun lon shefar ara eretz goshen, veaf al gav deaiku lon begaluta, la adu ara minnehon, dichtiv, (Shemot 9) rak beeretz goshen asher sham bene yisrael vegomer. umetav ara demitzrayim hava, dichtiv, (Bereshit 46) bemetav haaretz beeretz rameses. vetu, dela adu middilhon kelum, dichtiv, (Shemot 9) umimmikne bene yisrael vegomer. veim kol da itdanu bechamma dinin.
512: Lon beara desayyfe alma, venatal lon ara dilhon. uma mitzrae, deavde kol hane tavan leyisrael, itdanu bechol innun dinin. ashshur veedom ushear ammin, dimikin lon, vekatlin lon, venatlin lon mamonehon, al achat kamma vechamma dekudesha berich hu bae leyakkara shemeh alayyhu, dichtiv, (Yechezkel 38:23) vehitgaddilti vehitkaddishti venodati. hatam bemitzrayim bemalka chad, vehacha bechol malchin dealma.

Ribbi shimon zakaf yedoy uvacha, veamar, vavy man deyizdaman behahu zimna, vezakkaa chulakeh man deyizdaman veyishtekach behahu zimna, vavy man deyizdaman behahu zimna, begin dechad yete kudesha berich hu lefakda leayyaylta, yistakkal man innun dekayymin bahadah, bechol innun demishtakkeche immah, bechol ovadoy dechol chad vechad, vela yishtekach zakkay. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 63:5) veabbit veen ozer. vechamma aktin al aktin leyisrael.

Zakkaa man deyizdaman veyishtekach behahu zimna, begin dehahu deyitkayyaym behahu zimna bimhemanuta, yizke lehahu nehiru dechedva demalka. veal hahu zimna ketiv, (Zecharya 13:9) utzeraftim kitzrof et hakkesef uvechantim kivchon et hazzahav vegomer.

Levatar deinnun aktin mitare al yisrael, vechol ammin umalchehon yityayatun kachada alayyhu, umitare kamma gezerin bishin, kullehu salke beeta chada alayyhu, veyetun akta al akta, batrayyta meshakkechan kamayyta. keden yitchaze chad ammuda deesha, kaim meella letatta, arbein yomin, vechol ammin dealma chaman leh.

Behahu zimna, yittear malka meshicha, lenafka miggo ginta deeden, mehahu atar (balak 104 amud bet) deitkere kan tzippor, veyittear beara (Vayikra 212 2) degalil, vehahu yoma deyippuk letamman, yitraggaz kol alma, vechol bene alma mitchabbein go mearte vetinnare, dela yachshevun leishtezava. veal hahu zimna ketiv, (Yeshayahu 2:19) uvau bimarot tzurim uvimchillot afar mippene pachad Adonai umehadar geono bekumo laarotz haaretz.

Mippene pachad Adonai, da hahu regizu dechol alma. umehadar geono da mashiach. bekumo laarotz haaretz, kad yekum veyitgele beara (vayyar 119 amud alef, 221) degalil, begin deihu hu atar kadmaa deitcharva beara kaddisha, uvegin kach, yitgele tamman kadmaa lechol atar, umittamman yittear keravin lechol alma.

Levatar arbein yomin, deammuda yekum meara lishmayya, leenehon dechol alma, umashiach yitgele, yekum missetar mizrach, chad (Vayikra 212 amud bet, Bereshit 119 1) kochava melahata bechol gavvnin, veshiva kochavin acharanin desacharan lehahu kochava, veyaggichun beh kerava bechol sitrin, telat zimnin beyoma, ad shivin yomin, vechol bene alma chaman.

Vehahu kochava, yaggiach behu kerava, betisin denura, melahatin menatztzetzin lechol ever, uvatash behu, ad devala lon, bechol ramsha veramsha, uveyoma appik lon. veyaggichun kerava leenehon dechol alma, vechen bechol yoma, ad shivin yomin. levatar shivin yomin, yitgeniz hahu kochava, veyitgeniz mashiach, ad teresar yarchin, veyithaddar hahu ammuda deesha kemillekadmin, uveh yitgeniz mashiach, vehahu ammuda la yitchaze.

Levatar teresar yarchin, yesalkun leh lemashiach, behahu ammuda, lego rekia, vetamman yekabbel tukepa veitra demalchuta. vechad nachit, yitchaze hahu ammuda deesha kemillekaddemin, leenehon dechol alma, veyitgele levatar mashiach, veyitkanneshun legabbeh ammin saggiin, veyittear keravin bechol alma. uvehahu zimna yittear kudesha berich hu gevureteh lechol ammin dealma, umalka meshicha yityeda bechol alma, vechol malchin dealma yitarun leitchabbera leaggacha kerava beh.

Vechamma (ammin) mipperitze yehudain yithappechu leahaddera legabbayyhu, veyetun immehon, leaggacha kerava al malka meshicha. keden yitchashshach kol alma chamesh esre yomin, vesaggiin meamma deyisrael yehon metin behahu chashocha. veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 60:2) ki hinne hachoshech yechasse eretz vaarafel leummim.
513: Yikkare kan tzippor lefanycha badderech bechol etz o al haaretz efrochim o betzim vehaem rovetzet vegomer, shallech teshallach et haem vegomer, hay kera okimna leh, veihu chad mippikkude orayyta genizin, vaanan it lan beh raziyi deorayyta genizin, shevilin vearchin yedian lechavrayyay, beinun telatin uteren shevilin deorayyta.

Amar ribbi shimon leribbi elazar bereh, elazar, bezimna deyittear malka meshicha, kamma atin venissin acharanin yittearun bealma. ta chaze, beginta deeden diltatta, it atar chad ganiz vetamir dela ityeda, veihu merukkema bechamma gavvnin, uveh genizin elef hechalin dechissufin. velet man deayil behu, bar mashiach, deihu kaim tadir beginta deeden.

Vechol ginta mesachara birtichin saggiin detzadikayya, umashiach kaim alayyhu, veal kamma chelin umashiryayn denishmatin detzadikayya tamman, uverashe yarche, uvizmanne, uveshabbate, mashiach al behahu atar leishtashea bechol innun hechalin.

Lego lego mikkol innun hechalin, it atar achara tamir veganiz dela ityeda kelal, veikre eden. velet man deyachil leminda beh. umashiach agniz (sefer acher yitgele) levar, sacharaneh dehahu atar, ad deitgele leh chad atar. deikre kan tzippor, veihu atar dechariz aleh hahu tzippor. deittear beginta deeden bechol yoma.

Uvehahu atar, merukkeman deyyukenin dechol shear ammin, deitkenashu alayyhu deyisrael leavasha lon. al behahu atar, zakif enoy, vechaze avahan, dealin becharban bet elaha, ad dechame lerachel (Shemot 12 amud alef) dedimaha beanpaha, vekudesha berich hu menachem lah, vela tzeviat lekabbela tanchumin, kema deat amar, (Yirmeyahu 31:15) meana lehinnachem al baneha. keden. mashiach arim kaleh uvache, veizdaza kol ginta deeden, vechol innun tzaddikayya detamman gau uvachu immeh.

Gae uvache zimna tinyayna, veizdaza hahu rekia deal gabbe ginta, elef vechamesh mea ribbo mashreyayn illain, ad demate lego kurseyay illaa. keden, kudesha berich hu ramiz lehahu tzippara, veal lehahu ken dilah, veyatva legabbe mashiach, vekare ma dekare, veittear ma deittear.

Ad demiggo kurseyay kaddisha, itkere telat zimnin hahu kan tzippor, umashiach, vecholla sallekin leella, veume lon kudesha berich hu, leabera malchu chayyayva min alma, al yeda demashiach, ulenakma nakmin deyisrael. vechol innun tavvavn, dezamin kudesha berich hu lemebad leammeh. vetav hahu kan tzippor umashiach leducheteh. vetav mashiach veitgeniz go hahu atar kemillekaddemin.

Uvezimna deyittear kudesha berich hu leatkena almin, veitnehiru atvavn dishmeh bishlimu, yod beHei, (leatkena) vav beHei, lemeheve kolla bishlimu chad. keden yittear chad kochava dechilla, beemtza rekia, kegaven argevavna, lahit venatzitz bimama leenehon dechol alma.

Vikum chad shalhova deeshsha missitra detzafon, go rekia, vikum da lokovel da arbein (172 2) yomin veyitbahalun kol bene alma. lesof arbein yomin, yaggichun kerava, kochava veshalhova, leenehon decholla, veyitpashshat hahu shalhova bikidu deeshsha, missitra detzafon, go rekia, veyachashov lemivla hahu kochava, vechamma shallitin umalchin veumayya veamamya, yitbahalun mehay.

Keden yistallak hahu kochava listar darom, veyishshelot al hahu shalhova, vehahu shalhova yitbela zeer zeer birkia, mikkame hahu kochava, ad dela yitchaze kelal. keden, hahu kochava yaved orchin birkia, bitresar techumin, vekayymin innun nehorin birkia teresar yomin.

Levatar teresar yomin yizdazeun kol bene alma, veyitchashshach shimsha befalgut yoma, kema deitchashshach yoma deitcharav be makdesha, ad dela yitchazun shemayya veara. veyittear chad kalla beraam vezikin, veitchalchala ara mehahu kalla, vechamma chelin umashiryayn yemutun minneh.
Vehahu yoma, yittear bekarta deromi rabbeta, chad shalhova deeshsha, behahu kalla deyittear bechol
514: Alma. veyokid kamma migdalin, vechamma hechalin, vechamma migdalin yippelun, vechamma pardashke veravreve yippelun behahu yoma vechullehu, yitkanneshun alla levish. vechol bene alma la yachlin (sefer acher yachshevun) leishtezava.

Mehahu yoma, ad teresar yarchin, yityaatun kol malchaya, veyigzerun kamma gezerot, vechamma shemadot al yisrael, veyitzlechun beh (nusach acher behon), kema deittemar zakkaa ihu man deyira tamman, vezakkaa ihu man dela yiara tamman vechol alma yehe beirvuveya sagya.

Lesof teresar yarche, yakum shevet miyyisrael, da malka meshicha, deyittear go ginta deeden. vechol innun tzaddikayya yaterun leh tamman, veyachgerun leh mane zayyna, beatvavn reshiman demane dishma kaddisha.

Vekala yitpotzetz beanfe illanin deginta, kare bechayil, veamar, itaru kaddishe elyonin, kumu mikkame meshicha, ha idana leitchabbera itteta bevalah, uvalah bae lenakma lah nukemin dealma, uleakama lah, uleanara lah meafra.
Keden yekumun kullehu, veyachgerun leh kemillekaddemin mane zayyneh, avraham mimineh, yitzchak missomaleh, yaakov kameh, moshe raya mehemna, al kol illen tzaddikayya, azil verakid go ginta deeden.

Kevan deitkan mashiach, al yeda detzadikayya beginta deeden. yeul behahu ducheta deikre kan tzippor kemillekaddemin, vechame tamman hahu diyyukena decharban bet makdesha, vechullehu tzaddikayya deitketalu beh. keden natil mittamman (sefer acher asar) levushin, veinnun (nusach acher veikrun) eser levushe kina. veyitgeniz tamman arbein yomin, dela itgalya kelal.

Lesof arbein yomin, kala chad yittear, veyitkere miggo kuresyyay illaa, hahu kan tzippor bemalka meshicha deitgeniz beh. ucheden sallekin leh leella, vekudesha berich hu chame leh lemalka meshicha, mitlavash bilvusha nukema, vechagir mane zayyne natil leh, venashik leh al resheh.

Keden, mizdazean 3 mea vetishin rekiin, vearmiz kudesha berich hu lechad rekia meinun dehava ganiz misheshet yeme bereshit, veappik mechad hechla divhahu rekia (teruma 132 1) chad kitra gelifa, mechakkeka bishmahan kaddishin. behahu itra itattar kudesha berich hu, kad avru yisrael yat yamma, lemetal nukemin mikkol retiche paro ufarashoy, veatar leh lemalka meshicha.

Kevan deitattar veittakkan bechol hane tikkunin, natil leh kudesha berich hu venashik leh kemillekaddemin. man chame, retichin kaddishin, umashiryayn illain, desacharin leh, veyahavin leh mattenan unevizbezan saggiin, veyitattar mikkullehu.

Al tamman bechad hechla, vechame kol innun malache illae, deikrun avele tziyyon, innun devachu al charban be makdesha, uvachan tadir, veinnun yahavin leh chad purefira sumaka, lemebad nukemin. keden, kudesha berich hu ganiz leh behahu kan tzippor, veitkasse tamman telatin yomin.

Levatar telatin yomin, behahu kan tzippor, yechut meutar bechol innun tikkunin meella umittatta, chamma mashiryayn kaddishin sacharaneh, veyechmun kol alma, chad nehiru, tale merkia leara, veyekum shiva yomin, vechol bene alma yitmehun veyitbahalun, vela yindeun kelal, bar innun chakkimin, deyadin berazin illen, zakkaa chulakehon.

Vechol innun shiva yomin yitated (sefer acher yitattar) beara, behahu kan tzippor. bean atar. badderech, da kevurat rachel, deihi kayyeyma befarashat orchin. vivasser lah, vayyinachem lah, ucheden tekabbel tanchumin, vetakum vetnashik leh.
Levatar yekum hahu nehiru mehahu atar, veshare biyricho karta deilane. bechol etz da yericho. o al haaretz, da yerushelem. viyhe ganiz behahu nehiru dekan tzippor teresar yarche.

Batar teresar yarche, yizdekaf hahu nehiru ben shemayya veara, veyishre (Shemot 7 amud bet) beara degalil, detamman hava sheruta degaluta deyisrael. vetamman yitgele mehahu nehiru dekan tzippor, vetav leatreh. vehahu yoma yizdaza kol ara kemillekaddemin, missayyfe shemayya ad
515: Sayyfe shemayya, ucheden yechozun (yindeun) kol alma, deha itgele malka meshicha, beara degalil.

Veyitkanneshun leh kol innun delaan beorayyta, veinnun zeirin bealma. uvizchut yenuke deve rav, yittakef cheleh leitgabbera, veraza da efrochim. vei la yishtekchun illen, ha yenuke deyatvin betukepa deimmehon veyanke, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 28:9) gemule mechalav attike mishshadayim. vehayeynu o vetzim, divgin illen, sharya shechinta immehon deyisrael begaluta.

Deha chakkimin zeirin innun deyishtakkechun behahu zimna, vehayeynu (Devarim 22:6) vehaem rovetzet al haefrochim o al habbetzim, lo tikkach haem al habbanim (deha beh lo kayyeyma mela leappaka miggaluta ella bemalka ilaa, dechevan deinnun ravyayn vaynavekayn yahavin tukepa lemalka meshicha keden ema ilaa dehi rabeyaa alayyhu ytearet legabbe balah) veyitakkav (hachi) ad teresar yarchin acharanin. levatar, yete balah, veyokim lah meafra, kema deat amer, (Amos 9:11) akim et sukkat david hannofalet.

Behahu yoma, malka meshicha shaare veyichnosh galuta, missayyfe alma ad sayyfe alma, kema deat amer (dabeham 30) im yihye niddachacha biktze hashshamayim vegomer. mehahu yoma, kol atin venissin ugevuran deavad kudesha berich hu bemitzrayim, yaavid lon leyisrael, kema deat amer (Micha 7:15) kime tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim arennu niflaot.

Amar rabbi shimon, elazar beri, kol illen millin tishkach beraza dittelatin uteren shevilin devishma kaddisha, vead denissin illen la yittearun bealma, la yishtelim raza dishma kaddisha, vela tittear leahava, kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 2:7) hishbati etchem benot yerushalayim bitzvaot. bitzvaot: da malka (nusach acher meshicha) deikre tzevaot. o beaylot hassade shear chelin umashshiryayn diltatta. im tairu veim teorru et haahava: da yemina dekudesha berich hu, deikre ahava. ad shettechpatz hahi dishchivat leafra, vihe reuta demalka bah. zakkaa ihu man deyizke lehahu dara, zakkaa ihu bealma den, vezakkaa ihu bealma deate.

Rabbi shimon arim yedoy bitzllo lekudesha berich hu, vetzalle tzeloteh, levatar detzalle tzeloteh, atu Rabbi elazar bereh, ver abba veyatvu kameh. ad dehavu yatve kameh, chamu chad nehiru dimama deitchashach, veishteka chad tzinnora (tzerora) deshalhova deeshsha go yamma ditverya, veizdaza kol hahu atar.

Amar rabbi shimon, vadday hashsheta hu idana, dekudesha berich hu idkar livnoy, veachit teren dimin lego yamma rabba. vechad nachtin, pagin behay tzinnora deshalhova deeshsha, veyishtaku da beda beyamma. bacha rabbi shimon uvachu chavrayyay.

Amar rabbi shimon, ha ittearna beraze deatvavn dishma kaddisha, besitra deitaruta dileh, legabbe benoy, aval hasheta, it li legallaa, ma dela ityehiv reshu lebar nash achara legallaa. ella zechu dedara da, yekayyem alma ad deyete malka meshicha. amar rabbi shimon ler elazar bereh uleribbi abba, kumu bekiumayychu. kamu Rabbi elazar 206 abba. bacha rabbi shimon zimna achara, amar vavy man yekum bema deamina (nusach acher dachamena) galuta yitmeshach, man yachil lemisbal.

Uf ihu kam veamar (Yeshayahu 26:13) Adonai elohenu bealunu adonim zulatecha levad becha nazkir shemecha hay kera ukemuha. aval behay kera it raza illaa, go mehemanuta. Adonai elohenu: da hu sheruta derazin illain, atar demittamman nafkin kol nehiru deshraggin kullehu leadleka. vetamman talya kol raza dimhemanuta, shema da shallit al kolla.
Bealunu adonim zulatecha. deha amma deyisrael, let man deshallit aleh bar shema illaa da. vehasheta begaluta shallit aleh sitra achara.

Levad becha nazkir shemecha. raza dishma kaddisha, kelala deesrin uteren atvavn, uchenset yisrael la mitbarcha ella miggo shema da deikre becha, kema deat amer (Shemot 32:13) asher nishbata lahem bach (Bereshit 48:20) becha yevarech yisrael. (Tehillim 18:30) ki becha arutz gedud. uvizmena dishlimu ishtechach, la hava mitperash da min da. veasir
516: Leafresha da min da, itteta mibbalah, lav berayoni, velav bidchiru, begin dela leachazaa piruda, vehashsheta begaluta piruda ishtechach, demiggo aku dechol zimna vezimna, anan avdin piruda, leadkera hahu shem, bar mibbalah, begin deihi shechivat leafra, vehayeynu levad becha nazkir shemecha.
Bar mibbalah, anan dachrin lehay shem beferuda, begin daanan rechikin minach, veshaltin acharanin alan, ushemecha ihu beferuda min shema deikre becha, vehay beyome degaluta.

Begin degaluta kadmaa hava mibbayit rishon, uvayit rishon hu raza de kadmaa, velokovel 70 shenin dilah, galuta devayit rishon hava 70 shenin, veinnun 70 shenin la ishtechachat ima revia alayyhu, vahava piruda min shema illaa, raza de illaa. ucheden yod, raza illaa, istallak leella leella leen sof, uvayit rishon illaa kaddisha, la nevia neviu demayin chayyin, deha mekora dilah istallak.

Veihi 70 (Bereshit 248 1) shenin begaluta, begin deihi 7 shenin ikre, kema deat amer (Melachim 1 6:38) vayyivnehu sheva shanim. vei tema, deshalta malchut bavel leella beraza de shenin, chas veshalom. ella bezimna dehava be makdesha kayyaym, nehora uneviu deima illaa, hava nahir venachit letatta. kevan dechatu yisrael, veitcharav makdesha, veshalta malchut bavel, hava chafe, veachshich hahu nehiru, vetattae kaddishin la havo nehirin.

Kevan detattae la havo nehirin, begin (miggo) shaltanu demalchuta devavel. istallak hahu nehora, vehahu mabbua illaa dehava nevia raza dey, istallak leella leella been sof, keden innun 70 shenin la havo nehirin, begin hahu nehiru deitmena. veda hu vday galuta de shenin.

Kevan deadiu shultanu devavel, veshariat hei tattaa leanhara. yisrael kullehu, la ahadru leadkaa (nusach acher leshalletaa) lemeheve segula shelemata kemillekaddemin, ella zeer zeer, (beirbuveya) vechevan dishlimu la ishtechach, (usheriat hei tattaa leshalletaa) keden, 10 neviu illaa la nachit kol kach leanhara, kema dehava kemillekaddemin, ella zeer zeer beirbuveya, dela havo dachyayn kemillekaddemin kema deitchaze, veal kach neviu illaa, vela nevia, vela nahir, ella deahadar leanhara zeer zeer, miggo dochaka (dismala) dishma. (nusach acher degaluta vedina)

Veal da, itgaru behu beyisrael keravin saggiin, ad dehachoshech yechasse eretz, vaAdonai tattaa itchashach, venaflat leara, uneviu illaa istallak kemillekaddemin, begin demalchut edom ittakkaf, veyisrael ahadru lesarchanayyhu.

Veal da, Adonai bayit sheni itcharav, vechol innun teresar shevatin dilah, kechusheban mashiryayn dilhon, innun begaluta demalchut edom. uneviu illaa, istallak mehahu neviu, dekayyeyma alah, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatztzadik avad, avad hahu neviu dimkora illaa, dehava nagid umashich milleella. (nusach acher 1001ravin saggiin umalchut yavan shalta alayyhu levatar dahedarev betiyyuveta ittakkafu alayyhu vaatakeypeyav lon uvegin deyisrael haderav lesarchanayyhu malchut edom ittakkaf uvet shene itcharav 12 tattaa atechashekat unefalat leara vanebayav illaa istallak mehahu mabbua dekayyeyma aleh kema deat ameraz hatztzaddik avad, avad hahu neviu dimkora ilaa dehava negidu mashuch aleh, may tama, din dahechashech yechasse eretz)

Ucheden hava piruda beHei, bayit sheni, veihi begaluta deedom, bechol innun terisar shevatin (nusach acher dilah) umashreyayn dilhon, teresar shevatin sallekin (Bereshit 247 1) lechusheban saggi, veal deraza (nusach acher veal da) de hava behu, (veal da vaAdonai) bechol hahu chushebana, (nusach acher chashocha) galuta itmeshach.

Raza derazin lechakkime libba itmesar. 10 shevatin elef shenin, teren shevatin matan shenin. sharu dimin leminpal, patach veamar, (Eicha 1:2) bacho tivke ballayla vedimatah al lechoyah. lesof teresar shevatin degaluta, lelya yitchashach leyisrael, ad deyittear vav, lizman shittin veshit shenin.

Levatar teresar shevatin, deinnun elef umatan shenin degaluta, ulevatar (74) shittin veshit shenin bechashocha delelya, keden, (Vayikra 26:42) vezacharti et beriti yaakov. da itaruta deat 6, deihu nefesh devet yaakov. veraza da, (Bereshit 46:26) kol hannefesh habbaa leyaakov mitzrayma vegomer shishshim vashesh, veihu 6, nefesh devayit sheni, raza de tattaa, veda 6 raza deshishshim vashesh, shishshim: leitaruta deyaakov. veshesh: leitaruta deyosef. veal da ihu vav, deinnun teren bechibbura chada, veraza chada.
Mittamman ulehala, yittear kudesha berich hu leinun nissin veatin
517: Dekaamaran, veyitarun al yisrael innun aktin dekaamaran, ucheden, (sefer acher veraza da) veaf et beriti yitzchak. ulevatar kad yaggiach malka meshicha keravin bechol alma bimina dekudesha berich hu, kema deat amer (Shemot 15:6) yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach. keden, veaf et beriti avraham ezkor, ulevatar vehaaretz ezkor, da Adonai batraa, behahu zimna ketiv, (Zecharya 14:9) vehaya Adonai lemelech al kol haaretz bayom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad.

Lesof shittin veshit shenin acharanin, deinnun mea utelatin uteren shenin, yitchazun atvavn bishma kaddisha, gelifan bishlimu, ela vetatta kedka yeot. veraza da 10 illaa vetattaa, vechol innun shevilin, deinnun telatin uteren shenin dichlilan beraza deat 6, 16, (nusach acher 26) raza dishlimu demea utelatin uteren.

Lesof mea utelatin uteren shenin acharanin, yitkayyem, leechoz bechanfot haaretz veyinnaaru reshaim mimmenna. veyitdakke ara kaddisha. vekudesha berich hu yittear metayyay deara kaddisha, vikumun chayyaylin chayyaylin beara degalil.

Ucheden yittear setimu dinviu illaa at 10, veyitkayyeymun telatin uteren shevilin bishlimu, lenagda letatta, veyitkayyeymun atvavn dishma kaddisha kullehu bekiyyumayyhu Adonai, dead kean la yehon bishlimu.

Ad zeman deyangid veyitmeshach hahu neviu illaa, bechibbura deatvavn, go Adonai (nusach acher 11) batraa, veda ihu lesof tashlum mea vearbein vearbea shenin acharanin deyishtallemun. veyitarun shear mete yisrael devishar aran.

Deyishtechach kol da (toldot 139 amud bet bammidrash hannelam) bechushban chet, deityeyshiv alma veyitbasam, veyitavar sitra achara (chivya bisha) mealma. vehe tattaa titmele miggo neviu illaa, vetitatar vetitnehir bishlimu. ucheden ketiv, (Yeshayahu 30:26) vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma veor hachamma yihye shivatayim.

Ad dihe shabbat laAdonai, lealkata nafshin betaanuge kedushsha, (da Adonai batraa) kol hahu elef sheviaa, veda ihu itaruta deruchin kaddishin, deamma deyisrael, leitlabbesha levatar shabbat, begufin acharanin kaddishin, leitkere kaddishin, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 4:3) vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar biyrushalam kadosh yeamer lo. ad kan millin derazin setimin.

Vayyakam melech chadash. Rabbi yosi amar, bechol yoma, kudesha berich hu avid malachin shelichan al alma, dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:4) ose malachav ruchot. asa la ketiv, ella ose, begin dechol yoma veyoma ose. uvehahu zimna itmana memana chad al mitzrayim, veda ihu dichtiv vayyakam melech chadash, chadash vadday.

Asher la yada et yosef: deha meatar deferuda havo, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 2:10) umishsham yippared vekadmaa mehahu piruda, nahara demitzrayim ihu. uvegin kach asher lo yada et yosef, atar dechol yichuda sharya beh, deikre tzaddik.

Rabbi elazar 206 yose havo azle beorcha, ukedimu binhora lemezal. chamu chad kochava dehava rahit missitra da, vechochava achara missitra da. amar ribbi elazar, hasheta mata zimna dechochve boker leshabbecha lemarihon, verahate middechilu veemata demarehon, leshabbecha ulezammera leh, hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 38:7) beran yachad kochve boker vayyariu kol beni elohim. begin dechullehu beyichuda chada ka meshabbechan leh.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 22:1) lamnatztzeach al ayyelet hashshachar mizmor ledavid. ayyelet hashshachar: dechad nehiru anpoy demizrach, veitparsha chashocha delelya, chad memana it listar mizrach, umashich chad chuta dinhiru distar darom, ad deate venafik shimsha, uvaka beinun kavve rekia, veanhir alma, vehahu chuta afrish chashocha delelya.

Keden ayyalta deshachra ate, veate nehiru ochama bekadru, leitchabbera bimama, venahir yemama. unehiru dimama, kalil veshaiv begavveh, lehahu ayyalta veal hay ayyalta, kad itperash miyyoma, levatar dechalil lah, amar david shirata, dichtiv lamnatztzeach al ayyelet hashshachar.
518: Eli eli lamma azavtani. deha itperash ayyalta deshachra, minnehiru dimama. ad dahavu azle, nahir yemama, umatta idan tzelota, amar ribbi elazar, netzalle tzelota venizil, yatvu vetzallu. levatar kamu veazlu.

Patach Rabbi elazar veamar (Kohelet 8:14) yesh hevel asher naasa al haaretz asher yesh tzaddikim asher maggia alehem kemaase harshaim vegomer amarti sheggam ze havel. hay kera (Bereshit 16 amud bet) ukemuha veittemar, aval yesh hevel, shelomo malka aved sifra da, veokim leh al shiva havalim, dealma kayyeyma alayyhu.
Veinnun shiva ammudin samchin dealma, lokovel shiva rekiim, veillen innun: vilon. rakia, shechakim zevul. maon. machon. aravot. ulokavlayyhu havel havalim amar kohelet havel havalim hakkol havel.
Kema deinnun shiva rekiin, veit acharanin dedavke behu, umitpashshete venafke minnayyhu, hachi name it havalim acharanin, demitpashshete venafke meillen, vechullehu amar shelomo.

Vehacha raza dechachmeta it beh. yesh hevel, denafka meinun havalim illain, dealma kayyeyma alayyhu, veda naasa al haaretz, veitkayyaym bekiumeh, veittakkaf betukepeh beovde ara, uvisliku desalleka meara, veda itmana al ara, vechol tukepa vekiyyuma dileh, beinun nishmatin detzaddikayya, deitlekitu meara, kad innun zakkain, ad la sarchu, beod deyahave recha tav, kegon chanoch, dichtiv beh, (Bereshit Adonai:24) veenennu ki lakach oto elohim. venatal leh ad la mata zimneh, veishtaasha beh, vechen shear zakkain dealma.

Detanenan, al teren millin, tzaddikayya mistalleke mealma ad la yimte zimnayyhu, chad, al chove dara, dechad asgiu chayyayvayya bealma, innun zakkain demishtakkeche benayyhu, ittafsun bechovehon, vechad kad itgele kame kudesha berich hu deyisrechun levatar, salik lon mealma, ad la mata zimnayyhu, hada hu dichtiv, (Kohelet 8:14) asher yesh tzaddikim asher maggia alehem kemaase harshaim, mate alayyhu dina dilella, keillu avdu chovin veovadin derashiayyay.

Deha zimna chada, shail ribbi yose ben ribbi yaakov, ish kefar ono bezimna deribbi akiva vechavroy istalaku mealma, umitu behahu gavvna, leribbi meir, amar leh, vechi ketiv da bechol orayyta kulah, amar leh vela, veha amar shelomo, asher yesh tzaddikim asher maggia alehem kemaase harshaim. mate alayyhu dina milleella, keillu avdu chovin veovadin derashiayyay. veyesh reshaim shemmaggia alehem kemaase hatztzaddikim, yatve besheket ushelam behay alma, dina la mata alayyhu, keillu avdu ovadin detzaddikayyay.

Amay, i begin deitgele kame kudesha berich hu, dituvun betiuveta, o deyippok minayyhu zara, diyhe keshot bealma, kegon terach denafak minnih zara dikshot, avraham. achaz, denafak minneh chizkiyyahu. ushear chayyayvin dealma. uvegin kach, besitra da, uvesitra da, hevel dekaamran, naasa veittakaf al haaretz, kidkamran.

Davar acher yesh hevel asher naasa al haaretz, kidkamran deittakkaf (veittakkaf) al alma. bemay, begin deyesh tzaddikim asher maggia alehem kemaase harshaim, matan lidayyhu keinnun ovadin dechayyayvayya, kegon bat ovde avoda zara, o chad meinun ovadin, deinnun mimmaase harshaim, veinnun kayyme bekiyyumayyhu, middechilu demarehon, vela baan leistaava, kegon kamma zakkae keshot dematu lidayyhu keovadin illen, veinnun gibbore choach, deavde reuta demarehon, vela chatu. veal da, hevel naasa al haaretz veittakaf betukepeh.

Veyesh reshaim shemmaggia alehem kemaase hatztzaddikim, mate lidayyhu chad mitzva, deihu ovada detzaddikayya, vezakkan bah, veavdin yatah. kegon listim mekappecha hava mishtechach beturayay, bahade innun listim ovde avoda zara, vechad hava yuday avar tamman, hava mashziv leh, venatir leh minnayyhu, vahava kare aleh ribbi akiva, yesh reshaim asher maggia alehem kemaase hatztzaddikim.
519: Beshivvuteh deribbi chiyyay, delelya chad paga bah behahi itteta dahavat azlat leve berattah. baa lemitkaf bah, amra leh, bematu minach, okir lemarach, vela techeta gabbay. shavkah vela chav bah. hve omer, veyesh reshaim asher maggia alehem kemaase hatztzaddikim amarti sheggam ze havel, kema deittakkaf hahu hevel, bahade innun tzaddikayya, dematu lidayyhu ovde dechayyayvayya, vela chatan. uf hachi, ittakkaf bahade innun chayyayvayya, demate lidayyhu ovade deinnun tzaddikayya, veavde lehu.

Detanenan aved kudesha berich hu tzaddikim ureshaim bealma. vechamma deityaykar ihu bealma, beovde detzaddikayya, hachi name ityaykar ihu berashiayyay, kad avde ovada tava bealma. kema deat amer, (Kohelet 3:11) et hakkol asa yafe veitto. vavy lachayyayva, kad avid garmeh ra, veittakkaf bechoveh, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 3:11) oy larasha ra vegomer.

Tu patach veamar, et hakkol raiti bime hevli vegomer. hay kera uf hachi ukemuha chavrayyay, aval kad ityehiv chachma lishlomo, chama kolla, bezimna deshalta sihara, yesh tzaddik da ammuda dealma. oved: kema deat amer, (yeshaya 3) hatztzaddik avad, bezimna degaluta betzidko: begin dehi shechivat leafra, tzedek da, kol zimna deyisrael begaluta, ihi immehon begaluta, uvegin kach, (Kohelet 7:15) tzaddik oved betzidko. deha la matan legabbeh innun birkan illain.

Veyesh rasha maarich beraato, da samael, deorich sheket veshalva leedom, bemay beraato. behahi raa itteh, (nusach acher ishsha raa eshet zenunim) (Hoshea 1) nachash takkifa, deha la mata alayyhu sheket veshalva, ella begin deitdabbak behahi nukeba. kegavvna da lishar malkevavn, ad dekudesha berich hu yakim meafra, lehahi sukkat david hannofelet, dichtiv, (Amos 7) akim et sukkat david hannofalet.

(Shemot 2:1) vayyelech ish mibbet levi. ribbi yose patach (Shir HaShirim 6:2) dodi yarad leganno laarugot habbosem vegomer. leganno: da keneset yisrael, begin dehi arugat habbosem, deihi kelila mikkol sitrin (nusach acher zine) busemin verechin dealma deate. beshaata dekudesha berich hu nachit leginta da (nusach acher deeden) kol innun nishmathon detzaddikayya, mitatteran tamman, kullehu yahave recha, kema deat amer vereach shemanayicha mikkol besamim, (nusach acher vereach appecha kattappuchim) illen innun nishmathon detzaddikayya, deamar ribbi yitzchak, kol innun nishmatin detzaddikayya, dehavu behay alma, vechol innun nishmatin, dizminin lenachta lehay alma, kullehu beginta (da kayymin

Beginta) di beara, (kullehu) kayymin bediyyukena vetziyyura dehavu kayymin behay alma, vesitra veraza da itmesar lechakkime. rucha denachit livne nasha, (tazria 45 amud bet) deihu missitra denukeba, mitgallefa tadir begillufa kehay chotam. tziyyura degufa devar nash behay alma, (73 amud bet) balit levar, verucha itgelif lego. kad itpashat rucha min gufa, hahu ruach balit beginta deara, betziyyura udeyukena degufeh mammash dibbehay alma, begin dehava tadir kachotam.

Veal da amra ihi, (Shir HaShirim 8:6) simeni kachotam, ma chotam galif begillufa lego, veittzayyayr betziyyura belita levar. uf hachi ihi rucha, dehava missitra dilah, kehay gavvna mammash behay alma, galif begillufa lego, vechad itpashat min gufa, veal beginta deara, avira detamman balit hahu gillufa leittzayyeyra levar, veittzayyayr betziyyura belita levar, kegavvna detziyyura degufa behay alma (leella).
Nishmeta, deihi meilana dechayay, ittzayyayr tamman leella, behahu tzerora dechayye, leitanga benoam Adonai, kema deat amer (Tehillim 27:4) lachazot benoam Adonai ulevakker behechalo.

Vayyelecha ish mibbet levi, (Shemot 19 amud alef, Bereshit 174 amud alef, tazria 44) da gavriel, kema deat amer (Daniel 9:21) vehaish gavriel asher raiti vechazon vegomer. mibbet levi: da cheneset yisrael, deatya missitra dismala. vayyikkach et bat levi da nishmeta.
